articles.title: Do You Miss the Nights We Spent Crafting Figures? Rethinking Teaser and Framework Figures in the Age of Generative AI
articles.content: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. Generative AI offers new ways to realize these choices, raising questions about explanatory clarity and purposeful visual expression. We examine these questions through a visual retrospective of 371 motivation and framework figures from 200 papers. The corpus comprises a quota-based main sample of 160 papers spanning four temporal periods and a separate purposive style-contrast sample of 40 papers. A single multimodal judge evaluates six dimensions of communication and design, with three repeated judgments per figure. We attempt source-constrained revisions of all 371 figures, of which 369 pass the recorded fidelity checks. Original-figure ratings show no uniform decline across periods. Revisions increase mean clarity ratings by 0.428 points and decrease aesthetic coherence ratings by 0.111 points on a five-point scale. Gains in the six-dimension average are larger for main-sample motivation figures than for frameworks. Case analyses show that added explanation can clarify comparisons while leaving typographic hierarchy and visual economy unresolved. These model-based findings support researcher-led design, with AI assisting exploration and authors retaining responsibility for explanatory purpose, composition, and scientific relationships. The accompanying atlas and evaluation records are available at https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html.

articles.title_zh: 你想念我们花的夜 手工数字? 重新思考 " 茶叶 " 和 " 传统AI " 时代的框架数字
articles.content_zh: 科学人物通过抽象、组成和强调的选择,赋予研究思想一种视觉形式。 基因AI提供了实现这些选择的新方法,提出了解释性清晰度和有目的的视觉表达问题. 我们通过对200篇论文中的371个动机和框架数字的直观回顾来审查这些问题。 这份文书包括一份基于配额的主要样本,共160篇论文,涉及四个时间段,还有一份有目的的风格-冲突样本,涉及40篇论文。 单一的多式联运法官对通信和设计的六个方面进行评价,每个数字有三次重复判决。 我们试图对所有371个数字进行来源限制的修订,其中369个数字通过了记录的忠诚度检查。 原图收视率显示各个时期没有统一下降. 修订后将平均清晰度的评分增加0.428分,在5分尺度上将审美一致性的评分减少0.11分. 六分法平均收益主要动机数字大于框架。 案例分析显示,附加解释可以澄清比较,而排印结构与视觉经济则无法解决。 这些基于模型的调查结果支持研究人员主导的设计,AI协助勘探,作者保留解释目的、组成和科学关系的责任。 随附的地图集和评价记录见https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html。

articles.title: Where and Why is Grounded Reasoning Useful?
articles.content: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. However, the benefits and limitations of grounded reasoning are understudied. We study where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. To do so, we introduce a chain-of-thought analysis method to measure how much a model uses its outputted grounding in its thinking trace and perform a detailed ablation study of a grounded reasoning training recipe. We find that grounded reasoning improves counting but shows no significant gain over baselines without coordinate grounding across a wide range of spatial reasoning and perception benchmarks. Using several synthetic tasks, we show that grounded reasoning is most useful when a task requires undescribable references, which are visual concepts that are difficult to describe in language. However, we observe that many existing visual reasoning benchmarks are solvable with only describable text references. To close this gap, we introduce BrickVision, a new benchmark that requires undescribable visual references to solve.

articles.title_zh: 何地和为什么有理由有用?
articles.content_zh: 基础推理,即一个模型输出文本在思维链推理中相关地点的坐标,是解决复杂的视觉推理问题的共同策略. 然而,对有根据的推理的利弊和局限性的研究不足。 我们研究何地和为什么有根据的推理最有用。 为此,我们采用了一种思维链式分析方法,以衡量一个模型在思维跟踪中在多大程度上使用了其输出的地面,并对一个基于推理的训练方法进行详细研究。 我们认为,有根据的推理改进了计数工作,但如果不在广泛的空间推理和感知基准方面进行协调,则在基线方面没有重大收益。 我们用几个合成任务来显示,当一项任务需要无法描述的引用时,基于推理最有用,这些是视觉概念,在语言中难以描述. 然而,我们发现,许多现有的视觉推理基准只能以可贬低的文字参考来解释。 为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了Brick Vision,这个新的基准需要无法描述的视觉参考来解决.

articles.title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
articles.content: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.

articles.title_zh: Ego Generalist:通过视频-Native建模实现Egocent Action-Video任务的统一
articles.content_zh: 现代的视频模型具有很强的视觉前科,但并非本土在度量3D空间中代表人类行动. 我们介绍Ego Generalist,它改造了经过预先训练的视频生成器,以统一以行动为条件的以自我为中心的视频生成器,提出估计,以及联合行动-视频生成器。 我们的角色适应动作渲染器为多方向动作-视频学习提供了视频-内在表现,使量子运动既可以用作空间控制信号,也可以用作可回收的生成目标. 跨流动作-视频耦合通过轻量级的适应,同时保留预先训练的视觉前缘,在度量运动和视觉动态之间建立密切的对应关系. 这些设计共同建立了一个涵盖五个行动视频任务的总体框架。 尽管仅对受控制的实验室录音进行改编,但Ego Generalist对各种不见的场景和互动进行了概括,具有有效的动作控制和视觉质量,连接了预先训练的视觉知识和衡量的3D人类运动.

articles.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
articles.content: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known structure of visual primitives to predict their coordinates jointly, using a lightweight drafter that generates an entire primitive in one forward pass. The layout adapts to the primitive's type, dimensionality, and length, supporting compact boxes and long, variable-length trajectories. Crucially, spatial accuracy need not require reproducing an autoregressive model's exact token sequence. VFlash therefore trains on annotated primitives and directly accepts structurally valid predictions without target-token agreement. Across the evaluated 2D and 3D robot trajectory tasks, VFlash consistently reduces prediction errors relative to autoregressive decoding. Preliminary single-rollout measurements indicate approximately 25x faster generation for 3D point motion forecasting. A world action model conditioned on VFlash plans achieves 70.2% average success across four MolmoSpaces task suites, compared with 62.6% for the baseline.

articles.title_zh: VFlash: 快速, 精确的视觉规划, 通过 Flash 原始解码
articles.content_zh: 物理AI任务的模型,如机器人和自主驾驶,不需要仅仅用语言来说明理由. 它们可以使用视觉图点,边框,以及轨迹来表示空间目标并预测运动. 然而,自动递减的愿景语言模型一次生成一个协调符号,使更丰富的预测越来越昂贵。 我们引入了VFlash,一种通过Flash Primitive Decoding进行快速,准确的视觉规划的方法. VFlash利用已知的视觉原始体结构来共同预测它们的坐标,使用一个轻量级的起草器,在一个前传中生成一个完整的原始体. 该布局适应原始人的类型,维度,以及长度,支撑紧凑的盒子和长,可变长的轨迹. 关键的是,空间精度不需要重现一个自动递归模型精确的符号序列. VFlash因此在附加注释的原始语上进行训练,直接接受结构上有效的预测,而无需达成目标键协议. 在被评价的2D和3D机器人轨迹任务中,VFlash持续减少相对于自递解码的预测错误. 初步的单滚式测量表明,3D点运动预测的生成速度约为25x. 一个以VFlash计划为条件的世界行动模式在四个MolmoSpace任务套件中取得了70.2%的平均成功,而基线为62.6%。

articles.title: Edge-Assisted Crowdsensing for Explainable Cyclist Safety Perception
articles.content: Cyclist fatality rates remain high despite policy support for active travel, and autonomous vehicles add complexity to mixed traffic. Neither crash statistics nor multi-model detection pipelines scale to continuous monitoring of perceived safety along a route. We present an edge-assisted crowdsensing system: handlebar cameras supply street-level frames, a vision-language model (VLM) turns each frame into structured traffic attributes through a single prompt, and an explainable boosting machine (EBM) combines them with OpenStreetMap road infrastructure and on-bike kinematics to predict a crowdsourced 1-9 safety score. Extraction belongs at the network edge: the fastest self-hosted model needs 2.49 s per frame and scoring takes 0.4 ms on a CPU. On 1,362 annotated frames from two London routes, the EBM regressor reaches 72.2 percent binary accuracy and a mean absolute error of 1.011 under five-fold cross-validation. It is within one accuracy point of black-box ensembles. Its per-feature shape functions give exact attribution: physical lane separation is worth +0.97 rating points, a painted lane +0.70 and a construction site -0.65. Planners can therefore price an infrastructure change in rating points, and the results enter cost-benefit analysis directly. We also report inter-annotator agreement (alpha = 0.4695), an attribute audit, and a sensitivity analysis linking attribute error to accuracy. With re-encoding, a 20 s sampling interval serves 1,000 riders at 54 Mbit/s at a cost of 1.4 accuracy points, making continuous monitoring practical.

articles.title_zh: 用于解释性循环安全感知的边缘人群
articles.content_zh: 尽管政策支持积极旅行,但自行车队的死亡率仍然很高,自主车辆增加了混合交通的复杂性。 既无坠机统计,也无多模式检测管道,无法持续监测沿途的安全感。 我们提出了一个边缘辅助的拥塞系统:手提箱摄像头提供街机级帧,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)通过单一的提示器将每个帧转化为结构化的交通属性,一个可解释的助推机(EBM)将其与OpenStreetMap路基建和骑动车手结合,以预测一个拥塞源1-9安全分数. 提取器属于网络边缘:最快的自装机型每帧需要2.49 s,积分在CPU上需要0.4ms. 在来自两条伦敦路线的1,362个注释框上,EBM递归器达到了72.2%的二进制精度,在5倍交叉验证下,平均绝对误差为1.011. 它在一个精确点 黑盒组合。 其每个地貌的形状功能给出了确切的归属:物理道分离值+0.97的评分点,一个漆色道+0.70和建筑工地−0.65. 因此,规划人员可以定价改变评级点的基础设施,结果直接输入成本效益分析。 我们还报告说明人之间的协议(alpha=0.4695),属性审计,以及将属性错误与准确性联系起来的敏感性分析. 通过重新编码,一个20s的采样间隔以54 Mbit/s的速度为1000个骑手服务,花费1.4的精确点,使得持续监测变得切实可行.

articles.title: SM4RT: Cascaded Feed-forward Model for 4D Reconstruction
articles.content: We introduce SM4RT, a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction from RGB videos. While existing feed-forward approaches typically address geometry reconstruction and motion estimation separately--and often predict motions in a single coordinate frame that must account for camera movement--SM4RT solves these tasks sequentially by first reconstructing 3D geometry and then bootstrapping motion estimation from the predicted structure. By expressing each pixel's 3D motion in its corresponding camera frame, SM4RT reduces ambiguity arising from camera motion. To address the sparsity of real-world motion labels, SM4RT further incorporates a weakly supervised loss that regularizes unlabeled point motions using labeled point positions at the other time step. We evaluate motion estimation on three dynamic-scene datasets--Kubric, Waymo, and Point Odyssey--and SM4RT achieves the best performance on most metrics compared with prior baselines. We additionally benchmark geometry reconstruction on five dynamic scene datasets and show that SM4RT achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods. Overall, our unified framework demonstrates that combining geometry reconstruction and motion estimation in a cascade not only avoids performance trade-offs but also enhances motion estimation through improved geometric reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SM4RT:4D重建的连锁饲料前置模型
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了SM4RT,一个多任务级联的Feed-forward模型,用于从RGB视频中进行动态场景重建. 虽然现有的向导方法通常分别处理几何重建和运动估计,而且往往在一个必须顾及相机运动的单一坐标框架内预测运动-SM4RT通过首先重建三维几何并然后从预测结构中拖动运动估计来依次解决这些任务。 通过在相应的相机框中表达每个像素的3D运动,SM4RT可以减少相机运动所产生的模糊性. 为解决现实世界运动标签的螺旋性问题,SM4RT进一步包含了一个弱监督损失,在另一个时段使用标签点位置将无标签点运动规范化. 我们评价三个动态场景数据集的动量估计 -- -- Kubric、Waymo和Point Odyssey-和SM4RT与以往基线相比,在大多数指标上都取得了最佳业绩。 我们另外在五个动态场景数据集上基准几何重建,并显示SM4RT以最先进的方法实现竞争性能. 总体而言,我们的统一框架表明,把几何重建和运动估计结合在一个级联中,不仅避免了性能的权衡,而且通过改进几何推理加强了运动估计。

articles.title: T3R: Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement Towards Efficient and Robust VLA Models
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control, but inference is increasingly expensive. Each decision processes hundreds of visual tokens, often across multiple cameras, leading to substantial computation while allowing irrelevant background content to distract action prediction under distribution shift. We argue that these issues stem from two complementary forms of redundancy: many visual tokens are spatially irrelevant, while attention over the remaining tokens is often misallocated. Based on this observation, we propose T3R, a Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement framework. In the first stage, segmentation-guided token pruning removes irrelevant visual patches to reduce computation and eliminate distracting context. In the second stage, saliency-guided attention biasing reallocates attention toward action-critical visual regions and language instructions within the retained tokens. Together, pruning produces a cleaner candidate set, while attention biasing further emphasizes the most decision-relevant evidence, yielding a better accuracy-efficiency frontier than either stage alone. On LIBERO-Spatial, T3R removes 85% of scene-camera visual tokens while essentially matching the unpruned success rate, and improves success by up to 7 percentage points under out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations. The timing comparison attributes 7.8 ms per inference call to pruning and attention-bias application. As input resolution increases, LLM-forward profiling shows up to a 3.3x speedup over the unpruned baseline. Evaluations across LIBERO, SIMPLER, and RoboTwin with three VLA backbones show the strongest accuracy-efficiency benefits in multi-camera settings. These results demonstrate that training-free token refinement is a practical approach to efficient and robust VLA inference.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: T3R: 面向高效和强大的VLA模式的免费培训
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型可以实现端对端机器人控制,但推论越来越昂贵. 每个决定都会处理数百个视觉符号,常常跨越多个相机,导致大量计算,同时允许不相关的背景内容分散分布转移下的行动预测. 我们认为,这些问题来自两种互补的冗余形式:许多视觉标志在空间上无关紧要,而对其他标志的注意往往被错分配。 基于这一看法,我们提议采用T3R,即免费培训双层托肯改进框架。 在第一阶段,分块制导的令牌浏览会移除无关的视觉补丁以减少计算,并消除分散上下文. 在第二阶段,引人注意的显著偏重是将注意力重新分配给保留标志内的动作关键视觉区域和语言指示。 抽查共同产生一套较清洁的候选人,而注意力偏差则进一步强调与决策最相关的证据,从而产生比两个阶段都更好的准确效率前沿。 在LIBERO-Spatrial上,T3R移除85%的场景-相机视觉标志,同时基本匹配未刷成功率,并在分配外物体放置扰动下提升成功率高达7个百分点. 计时比较将每个推论的7.8 ms 表示为 prun 和 ocredit-bias 应用. 随着输入分辨率的提高,LLM前向剖面显示比未铺设基线加快3.3x。 在LIBERO、SIMPLER和RoboTwin三个VLA主干网进行的评价显示,在多镜头环境中,精确效率效益最大。 这些结果表明,完善无培训标志性的工作是有效和有力地推论志愿军的一种实用方法。

articles.title: Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
articles.content: Humanoid robots are typically trained as solitary agents, leaving them unable to coordinate physically with human partners who naturally anticipate and adjust to one another. To bridge this gap, we present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates and executes socially responsive whole-body motion on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner's motion. Its high-level policy performs flexible sequence modeling of human and humanoid motion through a shared tokenized representation, generating reactive humanoid motion and anticipating the partner's motion when they are occluded, while a low-level whole-body tracking controller executes the generated motion on the robot. To train the system, we introduce a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure that retargets one interaction partner to the robot while morphing the other partner to preserve contact dynamics, reachability, and relative body scale. We apply this procedure across five motion-capture datasets to produce a new Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHI) benchmark of 260 hours of human-humanoid interactions. Our results demonstrate that Social Humanoid produces coordinated, human-aligned behavior across diverse interaction types in simulation and the real world. Project page: https://von31.github.io/social-humanoid/

articles.title_zh: 人类社会: 社会反应人类与人类的相互作用
articles.content_zh: 人造机器人一般被训练为单独代理,使他们无法与自然预期并相互适应的人类伙伴进行身体协调. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出社会人性(Social Humanoid),一种分级系统,在29-DoF Unitree G1上,以人类伴侣的运动为条件,产生并执行具有社会响应性的全身运动. 其高端政策通过共同的标注表示来进行人类和人文运动的灵活序列建模,产生反应性人文运动,并在被占据时预测伴侣的运动,而低端的全身跟踪控制器则执行机器人上产生的运动. 为了训练系统,我们引入了一个两阶段的适应性重定向程序,将一个互动伙伴重新瞄准机器人,同时使另一个伙伴形态化,以保持接触动力,可达性和相对体积. 我们把这一程序应用于五个移动捕获数据集,以产生260小时人与人互动的新人类-人互动基准。 我们的结果显示,“社会人类”在模拟和现实世界中,在各种相互作用类型中产生协调、人与人结合的行为。 项目网页:https://von31.github.io/social-humanoid/

articles.title: Adaptive Low-Light Enhancement for Road Anomaly Detection: A Multi-Architecture Benchmark and Edge Deployment Study
articles.content: Road anomaly detection systems on autonomous vehicles must function reliably under degraded visual conditions including darkness, rain, and Harmattan dust haze. This paper benchmarks four object detection architectures, YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, RT-DETR, and Faster R-CNN, under physically grounded lighting and weather degradation, and shows that uniform application of the SCI low-light enhancement network is actively harmful at dusk-level lighting (-16.1% to -30.7% mAP@50). We propose a lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router that selects between no enhancement, moderate SCI, and denoising plus strong SCI based on per-frame Rec. 601 luminance, recovering most of the dusk penalty while preserving low-light gains, and we validate the full pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Nano edge hardware.

articles.title_zh: 道路异常检测的适应性低光增强:多结构 基准和边际部署研究
articles.content_zh: 自主车辆上的道路异常探测系统必须在包括黑暗、雨和Harmattan尘雾在内的退化视觉条件下可靠运作。 本文将YOLOv8n,YOLOv12n,RT-DETR,以及更快的R-CNN四种物体检测架构作为基于物理的照明和天气退化的基准,并表明SCI低光增强网络的统一应用在黄昏灯光(16.1%至30.7% mAP@50)时具有积极危害性. 我们提出一个轻量级,无训练的润滑剂适应性路由器,在不增强,中度SCI,以及根据每帧Rec. 601的润滑剂进行除烟加强SCI之间选择,在保持低光度收益的同时回收大部分黄昏罚,我们验证NVIDIA Jetson Nano边缘硬件上的全管道.

articles.title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
articles.content: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.

articles.title_zh: MoMASPLAT:移动操纵的动态小说-视频演示增强功能
articles.content_zh: 通过模仿学习培训的维苏莫托尔政策对镜头视角的变化高度敏感. 这对于移动操控(MoMa)来说尤其成问题,因为由于导航不确定性,本地化漂移,以及环境限制,机器人很少从演示采集时所用的完全相同的基位进行操控. 近代方法使用新视觉合成(NVS)来用看不见的观点来增强演示,但是它们假设的是静态场景,因此在接触后互动阶段未能重新让出被操纵的物体,使得演示中最关键的部分没有被提升. 我们提出MOMASPLAT,是一种用于移动操纵的新视角演示增强框架,它从看不见的机器人基面合成了全部操纵轨迹,包括动态物体相互作用. 我们的关键见解是,标准的MOMA数据收集自然提供了重建静态场景和3D中被操纵物体所需的多视图观测. MOMASPLAT结合了3D高斯白板,向导3D基础模型,以及基于动能的动作重定向,分别重建场景和被操纵的物体,从新颖的观点使其形成,并生成几何一致的合成演示与变形动作配对. 我们评价MOMASPLAT在五个现实世界的移动操纵任务,这些任务涉及三个场景的刚性物体和清晰的物体,并验证其在模拟中针对地面真理的综合演示的忠实性。 MOMASPLAT大大改进了坚固度,使其达到不为人知的基数,使最强基线的平均成功率翻了一番以上,并在所有基准都失效的大型基数迁移中保持非三边成功,同时减少大规模实际世界数据收集的需要。

articles.title: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
articles.content: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 愿景SIM:超越理想的感应器-多模式 机器人感知模拟器
articles.content_zh: 机器人感知越来越依赖于将相机与新兴模式(活动、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热能)相结合的各种传感器套件。 然而现有的模拟器将这些传感器理想化,隐藏了限制现实世界部署的关键模式特定故障模式. 我们提出VisionSIM,这是一个统一的、以物理为基础的模拟平台,通过模拟各种常规和新兴模式的原始物理测量过程,将传感器现实主义提升到一流的关注。 我们揭露了对物理传感器参数的精细控制,复制了被通用模拟器忽略的故障模式:LiDAR的堆积和闪光;iToF的相位包装、饱和度和运动文物;事件摄像头的可逆滴;热相机的依赖历史的排放。 这使得能够就相同的场景和轨迹进行原则性的跨模式比较。 我们发布平台和大型室内数据集,同时提供同步原始测量和丰富的地面真实性说明.

articles.title: OraRefer: Segmentation-Guided Multi-Photograph Fusion for Oral Cancer Screening with Guaranteed Patient-Level Sensitivity
articles.content: Oral cancer and the oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMD) that can precede it are visible on the oral mucosa, which makes smartphone photographs a promising tool for screening. Deep learning models for this task classify individual photographs. However, screening refers patients, not photographs: a patient is usually photographed several times, and the referral decision must miss no more than a set share of patients with disease. We propose OraRefer, a patient-level screening model that reads each photograph with a segmentation-guided foundation model that conditions its class decision on the predicted lesion, combines all photographs of a patient with risk factors, and refers through a threshold with a finite-sample sensitivity guarantee. The model localizes the mouth itself, so inference needs no annotation. On 3000 photographs of 714 patients, patient-level fusion reaches an AUROC of 0.919 and outperforms attention-based multiple-instance learning. At a 90% sensitivity target, OraRefer detects 95% of patients with OPMD or cancer and misses 3 of 61 patients with cancer, at a specificity of 0.610. Because the threshold is calibrated without retraining, each clinic can set its own guaranteed operating point on a local calibration sample.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Ora Refer:分片-指导性口腔癌检查多摄影结合,保证患者的敏感度
articles.content_zh: 口腔癌和口腔潜在恶性疾病(OPMD)在口腔黏液中可见,这使得智能手机照片成为有希望的筛查工具. 这一任务的深层学习模型将个人照片分类. 然而,筛选指的是病人,而不是照片:病人通常会被拍照几次,转诊决定不得错过不超过一定比例的疾病病人. 我们提议Ora Refer,一种病人一级的筛选模型,它读取每张照片,并配有分块制导的基础模型,以预测的损伤为条件作出分类决定,将病人的所有照片与风险因素结合起来,并通过一个有限度的样本敏感性保障的阈值进行引用。 模型将嘴本身本地化,因此推论不需要注释. 在714名患者的3000张照片中,患者级聚变达到0.919的AUROC,并且超越了基于注意力的多层学习. 在90%的敏感度指标下,Ora Refer检测到95%的OPMD或癌症患者,61名癌症患者中有3人缺失,特异性为0.610. 由于阈值在没有再培训的情况下进行校准,每个诊所都可以在当地校准样本上设定自己的保证操作点.

articles.title: A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models
articles.content: This paper analyzes a bilevel formulation for learning the regularization parameter of combined local-global (CLG) optical flow models. The lower-level problem computes the flow from a Lucas--Kanade data term and a quadratic or total variation (TV) regularizer, and the upper-level problem selects the parameter that minimizes the squared distance to a ground-truth flow. The setting is finite-dimensional, and a full-rank assumption makes the lower-level solution unique. For the quadratic model we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of an optimal parameter, for every optimal parameter to be positive, and for strict local optimality. For TV regularization an optimal parameter always exists, because the lower-level solution vanishes for large parameters, and we give a sufficient condition for positivity that accounts for the coupling of the two flow components through the local structure tensors. Synthetic examples illustrate the conditions, including cases in which they fail.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 本地-全球联合光学流动模型双层优化开发理论分析
articles.content_zh: 本文分析了用于学习本地-全球(CLG)光学流动综合模型规范化参数的双层配体. 下层问题计算出来自卢卡斯-卡纳德数据术语和四极变异(TV)整流器的流量,上层问题选择了将平方距离最小化到地面真实流的参数. 设置是有限维的,一个全排名的假设使得低级解决方案独一无二. 对于四极模型,我们为存在一个最佳参数、每个最佳参数都是正的以及严格的局部优化提供了充分的条件。 对于电视规范化,一个最佳参数总是存在的, 因为低级的解决方案消失 对于大参数, 我们给一个足够条件 假设性 来解释两个流体组件 通过局部结构的分数。 合成实例说明了这些条件,包括失败的情况。

articles.title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
articles.content:
Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough.
  Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory.
  Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress).
  Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 美国B Gym: 闭环超声波视图匹配的测试台
articles.content_zh:
背景和目标: 我们的主要目标是超声波引导:移动探测器直到其图像与目标视图匹配. 指南每一部分的公布方法在单独的模拟器中进行评估。 我们问这些方法合并为一个指南是否足够。
方法: 我们建造了USB Gym,一个测试台,其标准引擎模拟来自公众病人CT的超声波,其网络绘制器官纹理来自CT标签. 其指南有3个可替换的部分(片段),1个器官分割器,1个控制器和1个奖赏,获得20种公布的方法,每集运行在相同60集的6个被搁置的病人身上. 在每一个插槽中,一种公布的方法 只有在这些病人身上检测得更好时 才能取代我们的方法。 这种组合和我们在20个新的CT上的原始指南越好,就是基准基线. 一个姿势甲骨文,读取精确的探测器 仅用于模拟,设置了参考。 下文是探讨的结果。
结果: 在这些CT上,探测器平均从目标视野开始16.0毫米;姿势甲骨文使其达到1.5毫米. 在固定组合时已知的结果中,只有图像-相似性奖励(SSIM)略微但可察觉地更好,所以组合就是我们以此奖励的指南. 这一组合是基准基线,以13.7毫米(甲骨文进步的16%)结束.
结论:将未调整的公布方法与我们的方法相结合,并没有指导目标视图附近的探测器;任务仍未得到充分探索。 测试台接受新方法;没有在硬件上测试向导.

articles.title: 4D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Micro-Doppler Differentiable Rendering
articles.content: Millimeter-wave radar resolves the micrometer displacements of a moving body as micro-Doppler, enabling gait, gesture, activity, pose and vital-sign sensing. Each task relies on a downstream model trained on real data, yet radar datasets lag orders of magnitude behind vision and language. Brute-force collection will not close that gap, and existing synthesis methods (forward-only simulators, learned generators and static-scene inverse renderers) cannot fit a real capture of a moving body, leaving a sim2real gap. We present 4D Point Splatting (4DPS), a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene to a real capture. Using the synchronized camera to initialize the room and body, we represent the scene as oriented points carrying material, normal and velocity, and splat each point into range and Doppler bins. Our output is the raw complex return a real radar records, so we apply the same signal processing on the rendered data to obtain any representation for training any SOTA downstream model. We fit 235 sequences on HuPR and 100 on RT-Pose, two datasets with different radars. Our reconstructions set the state of the art, with median correlations of 0.940 and 0.830 on range-azimuth, 0.829 and 0.695 on range-Doppler, and 0.988 and 0.966 on micro-Doppler. Our renders also set the state of the art in downstream sim2real gap. On RT-Pose, a pose model trained on them reaches 21.9 cm MPJPE on real data, against 16.7 cm for real training and 127.6 cm for the RF-Genesis baseline, where both the rendered- and real-trained models learn nearly the same features. Our custom CUDA kernels fit a sequence in 5.7 minutes on HuPR and 12.9 on RT-Pose on one H100, making dataset-scale inverse rendering of mmWave radar possible for the first time. This work can enable synthetic data generation for any human-centered downstream task and model, and scene editing for data augmentation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 毫米4D 点镀 波形雷达微多普勒可区分渲染
articles.content_zh: 毫米波雷达可以解决移动体作为微多普勒的微米移位问题,使运动步态、姿态、活动、姿势和生命感知成为可能。 每项任务都依赖于接受过真实数据培训的下游模型,然而雷达数据集的量级却落后于视觉和语言. 暴力收集不会拉近这一差距,现有的合成方法(前方的唯模拟器,学习的发电机和静态-场面反向渲染器)无法符合对移动体的真正捕捉,从而留下一个sim2real差距. 我们呈现的是4D点电镀(4DPS),一种基于物理学的异构渲染器,它符合一个明显的移动场景,可以真正捕获. 使用同步摄像头来初始化房间和身体,我们代表场景为方向点,携带材料,正常和速度,将每个点都浮到射程和多普勒宾箱中. 我们的输出是原始复合体返回一个真实的雷达记录, 所以我们在提供的数据上应用同样的信号处理, 以获得任何用于训练SOTA下游模型的表示。 我们在HuPR上装了235个序列,在RT-Pose上装了100个序列,两个数据集有不同的雷达. 我们的重建设定了最新水平,在射程-半径上,中位相对比为0.940和0.830,在射程-多普勒上,0.829和0.695,在微多普勒上,0.988和0.966。 我们的制作还把最先进的技术 设定在下游的实实在在的差距。 在RT-Pose上,经过培训的模型在真实数据上达到21.9厘米MPJPE,而实际培训为16.7厘米,RF-Genesis基线为127.6厘米,其中制成型模型和经过实际培训的模型都学习了几乎相同的特征。 我们自定义的CUDA内核在5.7分钟的HuPR和12.9的RT-Pose上安装了一个序列,使mmWave雷达的数据集级反渲染首次成为可能. 这项工作能够为任何以人为中心的下游任务和模型提供合成数据生成,并进行场景编辑以进行数据增强。

articles.title: InstantHand: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Hand Avatar Reconstruction from a Single Image
articles.content: Hand avatar reconstruction typically relies on multi-view capture or per-subject optimization, limiting its scalability. We introduce InstantHand, a feed-forward framework that constructs an animatable 3D Gaussian hand avatar from a single image using off-the-shelf MANO, camera, and mask estimates, without test-time optimization. Image-averaged losses provide insufficient supervision for alpha leakage, which thickens thin finger contours. To address this issue, we propose a Soft Alpha Band regularizer that concentrates supervision on silhouette boundaries. Furthermore, colors regressed from image features can drift toward a learned prior even in observed regions. Our Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer preserves observed appearance by transferring source colors according to each Gaussian's rendering contribution, while completing unobserved regions using the learned prior conditioned on global source identity. InstantHand constructs an avatar in 2.84 seconds and renders at 161 FPS, matching per-subject-optimized baselines on InterHand2.6M and remaining competitive in zero-shot evaluation on HanCo.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 即时手: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian 从单一图像复制 Animatable Hand Avatar 重建的浮雕
articles.content_zh: 手形重建一般依靠多视图捕获或每个主体优化,限制其可扩展性. 我们引入了InstantHand,一个向导的架构,它用现成的MANO,相机,和面具估计,从一个单一的图像中构建出一个可模拟的3D高斯手像,而不进行测试时间优化. 图像平均损失对α渗漏的监管不足,而α渗漏使手指轮廓变薄。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用软阿尔法乐队规范化器,集中对硅线边界进行监督. 此外,从图像特征上退下来的颜色甚至可以在观测到的地区向学习到的前科飘移。 我们的可靠性外观传输通过根据每个高斯的渲染贡献来传输源色,同时利用全球源特性所具备的事先条件来完成未观测区域,从而保留了被观测到的外观。 InstantHand在2.84秒内构建了Avatar,并以161 FPS制成,匹配InterHand2.6M上的每个主体优化基线,并在HanCo的零镜头评价中保持竞争力.

articles.title: ManimCode: Learning Visual Self-Correction for Educational Animation
articles.content: Manim supports precise, programmatic video generation, but a successfully rendered educational animation can still have visual defects, missing explanations, or incorrect content. Rendering does not directly identify the code changes needed to correct these visual failures, so feedback-driven revision is needed. Existing agentic frameworks use iterative rendering and revision but typically rely on large models, often proprietary. Existing Manim datasets primarily contain final programs and often lack quality verification and the trajectories of feedback and revisions needed to learn this refinement process. We introduce ManimData and ManimCode, a data and training framework for feedback-driven educational animation generation. We construct ManimData through a render-guided pipeline that iteratively generates, executes, reviews, and revises Manim programs with retrieved API documentation. Its 24,034 render-verified, quality-filtered records preserve intermediate programs, execution errors, visual critiques, and corrective revisions. We use role-conditioned supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories to train ManimCode, a single 4B model, to write, review, and revise animation programs. To improve correction of errors that differ from those in the collected trajectories, we then train the Reviser with reinforcement learning on self-generated states, using rendering outcomes and reference-free quality feedback. ManimCode achieves 96.6% and 97.0% render success on ManimData-test and ManimBench, compared with 52.6% and 82.0% for the untrained 4B model under the same inference setup, while also improving video quality scores from 2.48 to 2.94 and from 3.00 to 3.44. Integrating ManimCode into two long-form educational video generation systems increases completed videos from 19/117 to 107/117 and from 53/239 to 239/239, alongside improvements in educational effectiveness and visual quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ManimCode:教育动画的视觉自校
articles.content_zh: 马尼姆支持精确的,程序化的视频生成,但成功制作的教育动画仍然可能存在视觉缺陷,缺少解释,或内容不正确. 渲染不直接识别纠正这些视觉故障所需的代码修改,因此需要反馈驱动的修订. 现有的代理框架使用迭代渲染和修订,但一般依赖大型模型,往往是专有的. 现有的Manim数据集主要包含最终程序,往往缺乏质量核实以及学习这一完善过程所需的反馈和修改的轨迹. 我们介绍了ManimData和ManimCode,这是供反馈驱动的教育动画制作的数据和培训框架。 我们通过一个渲染导管构建了ManimData,该管道可以迭代生成,执行,审查和修改Manim程序,并使用检索的API文档. 它的24,034个经过校验、质量过滤的记录保存了中间程序、执行错误、视觉批评和修正。 我们利用这些轨迹上的角色条件监督微调来训练ManimCode, 一个单一的4B模型, 编写,审查和修改动画程序. 为了更好地纠正与所收集的轨迹不同的错误,我们然后对审校进行关于自我生成状态的强化学习,使用渲染结果和无参考质量反馈。 马尼姆 在ManimData测试和Manim Bench上,代码达到96.6%和97.0%,而在同一推论设置下,未经培训的4B模型则达到52.6%和82.0%,同时,视频质量分数也从2.48提高到2.94,从3.00提高到3.44。 将ManimCode纳入两个长式教育录像制作系统,完成的录像从19/117增加到107/117,从53/239增加到239/239,同时提高教育质量和视觉质量。

articles.title: Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction
articles.content: Online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene during capture: each keyframe spawns primitives once and refines them for only a few dozen iterations, leaving little chance to fix poor initialization or missing detail. Gaussians are also inherently soft, needing many overlaps for solid surfaces. We present Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting (HIBS), which brings beta kernels to incremental reconstruction. Their shape parameter interpolates between a soft, Gaussian-like profile and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel, acting as a confidence dial for geometry. Our confidence-aware spawning uses geometric observability and multi-view depth agreement to initialize both opacity and shape, producing solid primitives where geometry is verifiable and soft, correctable primitives where it is not. As online densification, error-driven relocation recycles stale primitives into photometric-error hotspots. Bounded beta kernel support enables exact tile culling and faster rasterization, and a closed-form, shape-preserving merging formulation provides a level-of-detail (LOD) hierarchy for fast optimization and real-time rendering. On Mip-NeRF 360 in the on-the-fly protocol, HIBS improves PSNR by up to 0.8 dB while reducing optimization time by up to 40%. Project page: https://linus-franke.com/hibs/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 等级递增 在线重建的 Beta 镀层
articles.content_zh: Online 3D Gaussian Splating在捕捉时重建了一个场景:每个键框一次地产出原始人,并且只精炼了几十个迭代,使得修复不良初始化或缺失细节的机会很少. 高斯人也具有内在的柔软性,对于固体表面需要许多重叠. 我们提出分级增生Beta Platting(HIBS),它为增生重建带来了β内核. 他们的形状参数介于柔软的,高斯式的剖面和扁平的,接近不平的冲浪器之间,起到几何的置信拨号作用. 我们的自信意识产卵利用几何可观察性和多视深度协议来初始化不透明与形状,产生固态原始物,其中几何物可核查,而软性,可矫正的原始物则不在. 作为在线密度化,错误驱动的迁移将 stale原始物回收到光度-error热点. 捆绑的β内核支持使得精确的瓦片凝聚和更快的光栅化得以实现,封闭式的,保形的结合配体为快速优化和实时渲染提供了细微分级(LOD). 在飞行协议中的Mip-NERF 360上,HIBS改进了PSNR,最高可达0.8 dB,同时将优化时间缩短至40%. 项目网页:https://linus-franke.com/hibs/

articles.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
articles.content: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.

articles.title_zh: 交互式视觉 Gym:在互动世界中与模拟用户评价视觉互动模型
articles.content_zh: 在当前物理任务期间支持用户的视觉交互模型需要闭环评价,其中助理响应可以改变随后的用户行为和任务结果. 现有基准主要依靠离线重播,因此无法捕捉到这些影响。 我们通过联合模拟可执行的任务环境和人类用户,引入了互动视觉体格(Interactive Visual Gym),这是对视觉互动模型进行闭路评价和培训的框架. 我们贡献了三个模拟器,这些模拟器在烹饪、家庭操控和移动界面领域重新创造日常任务和人与人相配合的行动空间,以及一个与助理合作的个性化用户模拟工具,同时纳入可控执行错误和其他计划外行为。 我们以IVG-Bench为框架进行即时分析,这一基准有315种互动情景。 将最新水平的VLM作为视觉交互模型来评价,揭示了巨大的局限性:表现最好的模型双子座4Argon,在时限内只完成了53.4%的任务,在事实基础和可操作的引导上表现出显著的弱点,而且往往过于缓慢,无法在考虑反应延迟时防止错误. 我们用一项人类研究来验证我们的评估协议,该研究发现我们互动质量的衡量和参与者偏好之间有78.5%的一致. 我们进一步表明,这些环境提供了有益的学习信号:在概念证明GRPO实验中,闭路训练提高了我们烹饪环境中Quen3.5-4B模型的任务成功和互动质量.

articles.title: Aligning Policy Encoders with a Shape Teacher
articles.content: 3D-aware representations can improve robotic manipulation by providing geometric information that is robust to changes in viewpoint, object position, and occlusion. However, using 3D inputs at deployment requires additional sensing and processing, making image-based policies more practical. We ask whether an image-based policy can acquire 3D shape information during training while retaining a purely image-based interface at deployment. We propose shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism that uses a pretrained 3D shape representation as an alignment target for an image-based policy encoder. Specifically, we use Point-MAE features from individual objects as targets for corresponding image patches, transferring geometric structure to the policy without changing its deployment inputs or architecture. On LIBERO, shape-teacher alignment produces image representations that are more structured around object shape and corresponding parts, while substantially accelerating policy convergence and improving success rates. For pretrained policies, convergence is accelerated by 4.7x and 5.6x on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively, without requiring the shape teacher or depth input at deployment.

articles.title_zh: 用形状老师对齐策略编码器
articles.content_zh: 3D-意识的表示方式可以通过提供几何信息来改进机器人的操纵,这些几何信息对于观点、物体位置和隐蔽性的变化是强有力的。 然而,在部署时使用三维输入需要额外的感知和处理,使基于图像的政策更加实用. 我们询问,基于图像的政策能否在培训期间获取三维形状信息,同时在部署时保留纯粹基于图像的界面。 我们提议进行形状-教师调整,这是一种培训时间机制,利用预先训练过的3D形状代表作为图像政策编码器的调整目标。 具体来说,我们使用单个对象的Point-MAE特性作为相应的图像补丁的目标,在不改变其部署输入或架构的情况下将几何结构转移给策略. 在LIBERO上,形状-教师对齐产生更围绕对象形状和相应部分结构的图像表现,同时大幅加快政策趋同,提高成功率. 对于经过预先训练的政策,在对象套房和空间套房上分别以4.7x和5.6x加速趋同,在部署时不需要形状老师或深度输入.

articles.title: DART: Domain-Agnostic Residual Transfer for Generalist Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Generalist Anomaly Detection (GAD) aims to detect anomalies in unseen domains using only a few reference samples. Recent normal-abnormal guided methods improve this setting by exploiting abnormal references, but their residuals often mix transferable anomaly cues with domain-specific appearance factors such as texture, geometry, and acquisition conditions. This residual domain entanglement limits cross-domain transfer and may produce spurious activations on novel domains. We propose DART, a plug-in framework for normal-abnormal guided GAD that learns to separate residuals into anomaly-relevant and domain-specific components. DART combines a Residual Disentanglement Module, which preserves anomaly-discriminative information while suppressing domain information, with Cross-Domain Meta-Training, which forms episodes across source domains to make the separation effective. The method is architecture-agnostic and can be inserted between residual computation and the detection head of existing GAD pipelines. Experiments on MVTec AD, VisA, and BraTS show consistent improvements over multiple base methods, with the largest gains under stronger domain shifts. https://github.com/aqeeelmirza/DART

articles.title_zh: DART: 用于一般异常检测的域外不可知残余物转移
articles.content_zh: 通用异常检测(GAD)旨在仅利用少数参考样本来检测未见域的异常. 最近的常态-异常制导方法通过利用异常的引用来改进这种设置,但其残留物往往将可转移的异常提示与特定域的外观因素混合在一起,如纹理,几何和获取条件. 这种剩余域缠绕限制了跨域转移,并可能在新域产生虚假的激活. 我们提出DART,这是正常-异常引导的GAD的插件框架,可以学习将残留物分离成异常相关和特定域的组件. DART结合了一个残余分散模块,该模块在压制域信息的同时保存异常-歧视信息,与跨域Meta-Training,它形成跨源域的事件,以使分离有效. 该方法具有架构不可知性,可以在剩余计算和现有GAD管道检测头之间插入. 在MVTec AD,VisA,和BratS上的实验显示,比起多个基方法,在较强域位移下,其收益最大. https://github.com/aqeeelmirza/DART 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
articles.content: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Splating anything: Gaussian Spaceing 正常化用于Feed-forward 3DGS跨任意场景
articles.content_zh: 我们发现,现有的向导3DGS方法有一个关键限制: 高斯的属性一般在一个光圈-距离-常态化的空间中进行预测,该空间能够对重建的几何学进行全局的光圈统计,而相邻的高斯中心之间的间隔仍然可以因场景尺度和相机配置而有很大差异. 这种不匹配导致高斯级目标发生系统性转变,导致监管模棱两可. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议用高斯中程常态化(GSNorm)来标注任何事物,它将高斯间距的强烈场景级统计可以用来为高斯的预测提供更一致的空间参考. 为了严格评估我们的方法,我们进一步确立了一个系统的基准,涵盖不同的数据集、输入伸缩度水平和具有挑战性的推论观点。 广泛的实验表明,Splating Anything实现了最先进的性能,在场景规模和视角的巨大差异下,特别显著的收获.

articles.title: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
articles.content: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 模拟视角几何: 将多种语文模式中的表述和行为分开
articles.content_zh: 多种语文模式可以模拟不同的观察者,但目前仍不清楚所指定的观点如何重塑其内部表述方式,以及这些变化是否指导其判断。 在这里,我们调查了在Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct中人物条件视觉趣味性的代表性几何. 在100个图像和53个提示性条件中,我们系统地改变人物的内容和用来介绍它的语言框架,同时记录行为评级和层次隐藏状态。 我们观测到整个处理深度的代表性几何的系统重组:早期的层主要编码图像身份,而人特异的结构则出现在后来的层中. 令人吃惊的是,迅速的设定比个人身份更能重新塑造内部代表,而个人内容对行为判断的影响更大。 这种脱离进一步表现在身份声明的最小程度上,即使没有改变答复,也会改变表述。 这些调查结果表明,代表距离不一定反映行为相关性。 更广泛地说,它们揭示了模拟视角是如何在人工认知系统的代表空间中作为独特的结构出现的,突出了内部代表的几何及其功能后果之间的根本区别.

articles.title: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training method for diffusion models, but most RL objectives roll out the current policy at every iteration, and with a many-step sampler these rollouts typically dominate the cost of training. Few-step models cut this cost, yet they model an average velocity over an interval, whereas existing RL objectives are built for an instantaneous velocity with a many-step sampler. We adapt RL objectives to few-step models systematically in three phases, namely a transformation, a decomposition and an adaptation. The transformation to $x$-space expresses each objective we consider through a common policy prediction, at the clean end by default and at an explicitly marked level for transition or flow-map objectives, so that objectives stated over densities, velocities or rewards become comparable. The decomposition writes the gradient of each of these objectives as the sum of a self-regression toward a reference and a reward augmentation, so that a method reduces, at the gradient level, to a choice of anchors and weights. The adaptation computes each anchor from a few-step model at the end of its transport or along its tangent, with the instantaneous velocity recovered from the network itself or from an auxiliary network. This yields few-step versions of FlowGRPO, AWM, DiffusionNFT, DiffusionOPSD and ReFL in one modular codebase. In our experiments, reward-gradient-based methods are the most effective when the reward is differentiable and its gradient is affordable; otherwise DiffusionNFT-style methods generally reach high rewards in relatively few iterations despite a sometimes higher per-iteration cost. Extra inference steps show no systematic aggregate benefit in our experiments, although selected outputs visibly improve with two to four times as many sampling steps as in training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NelectStepRL: 微调 少步传播模式与强化学习
articles.content_zh: 加强学习(RL)已经成为推广模式的标准培训后方法,但大多数RL目标在每个周期都推出现行政策,而且随着一个多步骤的取样器,这些推广通常主导培训成本。 很少步骤模型削减了这一成本,然而它们在一个间隔时间中模拟平均速度,而现有的RL目标则是用一个多步骤取样器为瞬时速度构建的。 我们分三个阶段,即转变、分解和适应阶段,系统地使生殖健康目标适应几个步骤的模式。 向美元-空间的转变体现了我们通过共同的政策预测所考虑的每个目标,即默认的清洁终点和明确标明的过渡或流动图目标水平,从而使所表述的密度、速度或回报等目标具有可比性。 分解法将每个这些目标的梯度写成自回归到参照和奖励增益的总和,这样一种方法在梯度上会降低到选择锚和权重的程度. 适应用从网络本身或从辅助网络中恢复的瞬时速度计算出每个锚在运输末端或正切线沿线的几步模型。 这在一个模块化的代码库中产生了FlowGRPO,AWM,DifmusionNFT,DifmusionOPSD和ReFL的几步版本. 在我们的实验中,以奖励为基础的方法在奖励是不同的而且其梯度可以承受的情况下最为有效;否则,分散式NFT式的方法一般在相对较少的重复中获得很高的奖励,尽管有时每次渗透的成本较高。 额外的推断步骤表明,我们的实验没有系统的总体效益,尽管选定的产出明显改进,抽样步骤是培训的2至4倍。

articles.title: Beyond Quadratic Attention: Separable Gaussian Operators for ODE Vision Transformers
articles.content: Self-attention carries a quadratic cost in token count, which limits how far Vision Transformers can scale with input resolution. We introduce SSoG, a separable sum-of-Gaussians spatial operator that replaces dense self-attention with a learned mixture of axis-factorized Gaussian kernels, reducing the per-layer cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to subquadratic in $N$. Unlike dot-product self-attention, whose Lipschitz constant is unbounded outside a compact input domain, SSoG with fixed kernels is globally Lipschitz continuous, which, via the Picard--Lindelöf theorem, guarantees that the continuous-depth variant has a unique solution on the whole integration interval, a global guarantee that dense-attention counterparts lack in general. On CIFAR-100 at $224\times224$, in a matched discrete-Transformer setting and in the continuous setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 2.2--4.1 points across three model widths while using 8.8--16.6\% fewer parameters, with depth and training recipe held fixed. In a looped-Transformer setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 5.4--8.1 points. We further probe inference-time scaling by evaluating on inputs up to $1024\times1024$ at matched batch size: in the continuous-depth (Neural ODE) architecture, SSoG reaches up to 154\% higher throughput and over 60\% lower peak memory than dense attention, with the gap widening as resolution grows, consistent with the difference in asymptotic cost. In the discrete and looped settings, SSoG also achieves over 30\% higher throughput than dense attention at this resolution. Together, these results establish SSoG as a practical, parameter-efficient, and theoretically grounded alternative to dense attention across discrete, weight-shared, and continuous-depth Transformer variants.

articles.title_zh: 超越二次曲线 注意: ODE 视野变换器可分离的高斯运算器
articles.content_zh: 自觉在符号计数中带有四重成本,这限制了Vision Transformers用输入解析度所能放大的距离. 我们引入了SSoG,一个可分离的Gausians空间操作器总和,它用轴构内核的学习混合物取代密集的自留心,将每层成本从$\mathcal{O}(N^2)美元降低到以$N$计的下方。 与点产品自我意向不同,Lipschitz常数在一个紧凑的输入域之外不受约束,具有固定内核的SSoG是全球Lipschitz连续的,它通过Picard-Lindelöf定理保证了连续深度变体对于整个集成间隔有一个独特的解决方案,这是密集的对等体普遍缺乏的全球保证. 在CIFAR-100以224\times224美元,在匹配的离散式转换器设置和连续式设置中,SSOG将Top-1的精度提高2.2-4.1分,跨越三个模型宽度,同时使用8.8-16.6+=更少的参数,并固定了深度和培训配方。 在环形转换器设置中,SSoG将Top-1的精度提高了5.4-8.1分. 我们进一步探究推断时间的尺度,通过按相应批量规模对高达1024\times1024美元的投入进行评估:在连续深度(Neural ODE)架构中,SSoG的吞吐量高达154%,峰值内存比密集关注低60%以上,随着分辨率的增大,差距不断扩大,这与不对称成本的差异是一致的。 在离散和环绕的设置中,SSOG在这个分辨率上也实现了超过30+Q的吞吐量高于密集关注. 这些结果共同确立了SSOG是一种实用的,参数高效的,理论上基于的替代方法,可以代替分散的,权重共享的,连续的深度变形器变体的密集关注.

articles.title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs
articles.content: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ProQuant:边际MLLM的逐步量化-认识培训
articles.content_zh: 具有令人印象深刻的感知和理解能力的多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)将使得一系列下游应用成为可能. 然而,它们的大量计算和内存要求阻碍了现实世界的实施,特别是对受资源制约的边缘设备。 量子化已成为部署大型模型的有效解决方案. 虽然训练后量子化(PTQ)成功保留了中等比特宽的性能(如W8A8),但在低比特量子化(如W4A8)下,其性能严重退化,尤其是对于更适合边缘部署的小型模型而言. 在本文中,我们提出ProQuant,一个为低位的MLLMs量身定制的新型重量-激活量子-意识培训(QAT)框架. 首先,为了使有限的微调数据集分布与预先训练的数据集分布保持一致,我们提议一个自我重贴标签(SRL)方案,以重新模拟开源多式联运数据集的响应. 第二,我们首先对多模式理解和语言建模能力采取脱钩的观点。 我们建议建立一个渐进区块激活机制,以优先考虑MM理解的恢复。 我们还引入了一个对视觉敏感的系数$\vec\$,有效识别MM关键层. 跨越各种基准的广泛实验,涵盖有2B-8B参数的模型,表明ProQuant大大超过现有方法. 例如,我们的W4A8 Quen3-VL-2B-指令将平均精度提高了6.6%,并实现了与完全精度对应的性能可比较,性能下降率只有1%左右. 代码见https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/。

articles.title: Multimodal Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Modeling
articles.content: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.

articles.title_zh: 3D 医疗远景-语言模型的多模式结构组合
articles.content_zh: 医学3D扫描和报告本质上是分级的,诊断提示集中在组织多个层次的特定解剖区. 然而,大多数医学视觉语言模型忽略了这种结构,未能专注于临床相关的解剖学. 我们引入了MedHiVE,它结合了等级视觉语言Soft Mixture-of-Experts(SMoE)与对比性学习,联合模型化精细解剖学和全球扫描背景. 据我们所知,MedHiVE是第一个通过解剖尺度组织的双层SMOE结构来引导视觉和文字符号的框架,它与3D医学成像的报告生成的解剖学-水平对比性对齐。 这取代了静态集合特征的直接区域文本调整和以往工作的仅愿景分级路径,代之以动态的、基于时间档的跨解剖尺度的跨模式信息流动。 MedHiVE通过两级可学习的符号路由机制运作,其中本地图像和文本特征首先通过本地的SMOE进行路由,然后被全球的SMOE融合成统一的多式联运表示. 相互矛盾的学习使解剖学层面和全球视觉语言在统一空间中的表述一致。 MeDHIVE通过解剖学监督对25,000+CT扫描进行预先培训,在6个数据集中持续超过11个最先进的方法,涉及3项任务:分割、分类和检测,表明分级模型的重要性。 MedHive的代码在github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHive上.

articles.title: Improving Context-Shift Robustness of Convolutional Networks via Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy
articles.content: Image classification models often encounter objects in diverse and unpredictable contexts at test time, which may differ substantially from those seen during training. This phenomenon, termed context shift, exposes a key fragility in neural networks: when models rely on non-causal contextual cues for prediction, shifts in context can lead to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework to improve the robustness of convolutional neural networks under context shift. Our approach leverages spatial feature attribution to guide models toward making predictions that rely less on contextual regions and more on object-relevant features. As a first step, recognizing a theoretical limitation of existing feature attribution methods we introduce a new variant, ContrastiveCAMs, which produces more faithful attribution maps of model predictions. Building on ContrastiveCAMs, we further propose Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), a modification of the standard cross-entropy loss that regularizes the model's attention by suppressing the influence of contextual regions, thereby improving robustness to context shift. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach on several medium-to-large scale datasets (Waterbirds, Spawrious, ImageNet/ImageNet-BG, Hard-ImageNet), and report consistent improvements in context-shift robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过上下文规范化的交叉输入,提高革命网络的上下文屏蔽强度
articles.content_zh: 图像分类模型往往在测试时遇到不同和不可预测的物体,这可能与培训时看到的大不相同。 这种现象被称为上下文变化,暴露了神经网络中的关键脆弱性:当模型依赖非原因上下文提示进行预测时,上下文变化会导致显著性能退化. 在本文中,我们提出了一个新的训练框架,以提高在环境变化下革命神经网络的稳健性. 我们的方法利用空间特征属性指导模型进行预测,这些预测较少依赖背景区域,更依赖与物体有关的特征。 作为第一步,认识到现有特征归属方法的理论局限性,我们引入了一个新的变体ContrastiveCAMs,该变体生成了更忠实的模型预测归属图. 在ContrestiveCAMs的基础上,我们进一步提出CR-CE(CR-CE),通过抑制上下文区域的影响,对标准跨上下文损失进行修改,使模型的注意力正规化,从而增强稳健性,使其转向上下文. 我们评价我们在若干中大规模数据集(水鸟、Spawrious、ImageNet/ImageNet-BG、Hard-ImageNet)上的做法的有效性,并报告在环境变化稳健性方面不断改进。

articles.title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
articles.content: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: La-JEPA:与后期世界模特的契约机器人政策
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型适应预先训练的视频发电机,视觉语言行动模型建立在预先训练的视觉语言主干线上;将政策架构和推论成本与设计用于生成而不是控制的大型变压器挂钩. 仍然不清楚这些面向一代的选择对控制的影响有多大。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了Latent Action JEPA(La-JEPA),这是一个紧凑的世界行动模式,其政策变迁器从零开始在经过预先培训的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的特性空间中培训。 在快速WAM之后,La-JEPA学会了在培训期间与行动共同预测未来特征,只产生推论性的行动. 在没有包含预训内容的政策中,La-JEPA在干净和随机的RoboTwin 2.0场景和LIBERO-Plus上以正确的指示实现了最先进的性能,同时使用的参数远远少于最强的竞争政策. 其运行速度大大快于快速WAM的可比性能,并且超过了以JEPA为基础的最接近方法,即LeapBot-WA和JEPA-WAM,在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上运行,而没有经过事先培训的政策骨干。 在四项实际机器人任务上,平均成功率可与0.5比0.5和高于非初步训练的基线相比。 通过对La-JEPA背后的选择进行设计研究,我们显示,JEPA的性能超过了VAE的潜质,最明显地是没有分布,培训时间的未来预测选择即使在未来预测被推论忽略,也会对政策产生重大影响。 我们纠正了LIBERO-Plus指令,因为官方发布的评估者将它们腐蚀到大多数变种,并重新评价了几个强大的开放基线. 没有先天性的政策骨干,La-JEPA比远大的政策更好,更快,说明机器人基础模型可能从为控制而设计的架构中受益,而不是代代相传.

articles.title: Interpretable Multimodal MRI-Clinical Fusion for Functional Outcome Prediction After Acute Ischemic Stroke
articles.content: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not consistently outperform single-modality clinical fusion. Feature-importance analysis identified age, NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden, and learned FLAIR representations as key contributors, while qualitative FLAIR activation maps showed responses over lesion-like regions. These findings suggest that compact day-1 FLAIR and ADC representations provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables and support interpretable, data-efficient outcome prediction in AIS.

articles.title_zh: 可解释的多模式核磁共振-临床聚变,用于在急性Ichemic Stroke之后对功能结果的预测
articles.content_zh: 本研究评价了第1天多模式核磁共振的附加预测值,用于预测急性异化中风(AIS)后三个月的功能结果. 分析了66名ADC、DWI、FLAIR的AIS病人和临床数据。 从每一种核磁共振模式中提取了三维预先训练的ResNet嵌入物,利用折叠同位的主要组件分析并结合了结构化的临床变量和ADC衍生的损伤生物标记而减少。 线性支持矢量机通过跨磁共振模式组合的8倍分级组交叉验证进行了评价. 只有临床模型的性能很强(AUC=0.899\pm 0.151美元),而只有核磁共振模型的性能显示有限歧视(AUC约0.67美元-0.73美元)。 在多模式配置中,FLAIR-临床聚变实现了最高平均跨验证性能(AUC=0.948\pm 0.061美元),其次是ADC-临床聚变(AUC=0.941\pm 0.094美元). 完全ADC-DWI-FLAIR核聚变并非一贯优于单模式临床聚变. 特征-重要性分析确定年龄、NIHSS分计数、ADC损伤负担以及学习的FLAIR表述是关键贡献者,而质量的FLAIR激活图则显示对类似损伤的区域的反应。 这些调查结果表明,紧凑的日-1FLAIR和ADC的表示提供了超出临床变量的补充预测信息,并支持AIS中可解释、数据效率高的结果预测。

articles.title: Detecting Weather Fronts from Satellite Observations: What Does Reanalysis Add?
articles.content: Weather fronts are transition regions between air masses with contrasting thermodynamic properties and are associated with mid-latitude precipitation and severe weather. We investigate machine learning (ML) methods for detecting weather fronts and quantify the contribution of reanalysis data to performance. We compare two configurations of the same ML model for pixel-wise frontal classification over the North Atlantic and Europe: (1) using only geostationary infrared satellite observations, and (2) additionally using 28 ERA5 reanalysis fields. The satellite-only model achieves a neighbourhood critical success index at a 150 km tolerance (CSI@150) of $0.402$, which lies within the range of agreement between analyses from different meteorological services. The satellite$+$ERA5 model achieves $0.575$, an improvement of $0.173$. Our analysis shows that low-level winds are the least predictable from the satellite representation ($R^2 = 0.23$, compared with $0.88$ for temperature), while removing winds or moisture causes the largest decreases in detection performance.

articles.title_zh: 通过卫星观测探测天气前沿: 重新分析会添加什么?
articles.content_zh: 气象战线是空气质量之间具有对比热力学特性的过渡区域,与中纬度降水和恶劣天气有关. 我们调查探测天气前沿的机器学习方法,量化重新分析数据对性能的贡献。 我们比较了北大西洋和欧洲同一种ML模型的前方像素分类的两个配置:(1) 只使用对地静止红外卫星观测,(2) 额外使用28个ERA5再分析场。 仅卫星模型在150公里(CSI@150)的容忍度上实现了邻近地区的关键成功指数,为0.402美元,这属于不同气象部门分析之间达成的协议范围。 卫星$+$ERA5模型达到0.575美元,改善1.73美元。 我们的分析表明,从卫星代表值(R^2 = 0.23美元,而温度为0.88美元)来看,低水平风的预测性最差,而去除风或湿度则造成探测性能最大的下降。

articles.title: MCUFlowNet: Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search for Optical Flow on Microcontrollers
articles.content: Dense optical flow allows small drones to avoid obstacles. However, few dense optical flow networks are designed for microcontrollers (MCUs) with neural accelerators, whose on-chip SRAM limits the input resolution. We present PACE-NAS, a macro-to-micro neural architecture search framework that decouples memory from latency: a macro design fixes the backbone and its peak SRAM, and a micro design searches operators and depths to trade accuracy against compiler-estimated latency. We apply it to EdgeFlowNet on a Grove Vision AI V2 board (Ethos-U55), where profiling locates the peak SRAM at the full-resolution output head. Replacing transposed convolutions with bilinear upsampling and convolutions lowers the peak SRAM by 18%, and two lightweight context modules lower the endpoint error (EPE) without raising the peak. All searched subnets share this peak, so the search needs no memory constraint. We name the Pareto-optimal models MCUFlowNet; the fastest variant, MCUFlowNet-S, runs 1.76x faster than a retrained EdgeFlowNet at a 1.6% higher EPE and, in simulated forest flights at 2 m/s, reaches the goal without collision in 51.5% of trials, against 41.8%. PACE-NAS also applies to semantic segmentation, where a searched PIDNet-S variant runs 1.17x faster at similar accuracy. Code is available at https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MCUFlowNet:微控制器上对光学流的硬件-智能神经结构搜索
articles.content_zh: ense光学流使得小型无人机能够避开障碍. 然而,很少为带有神经加速器的微控制器(MCU)设计密集的光学流网,其上芯SRAM限制了输入分辨率. 我们提出PACE-NAS,一个宏观到微观神经结构的搜索框架,将内存与耐久性脱钩:宏观设计修复主干及其峰值SRAM,以及一个微观设计搜索操作员和深度,以交易精确度与编译器估计的耐久性. 我们把它应用到EdgeFlowNet上的Grove Vision AI V2板(Ethos-U55)上,在全分辨率输出头处的剖面定位最高峰SRAM. 用双线式升标和缩标来取代转录式转录,将峰值SRAM降低18%,两个轻量级上下文模块在不提升峰值的情况下降低端点错误(EPE). 所有被搜索的子网都共享这个峰值,因此搜索不需要内存约束. 我们把Pareto-优化模型命名为MCUFlowNet;最快的变体MCUFlowNet-S运行速度比重新训练的EdgeFlowNet快1.6%,在模拟森林飞行中,每秒2米,在51.5%的试验中达到目标,比41.8%。 PACE-NAS也适用于语义分解,其中被搜索的PIDNet-S变体运行速度更快,精度相似. 代码见https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet.

articles.title: Fault-Guided Cross-Layer Prediction for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Feature reconstruction is widely used for unsupervised industrial anomaly detection in the single-class setting, where only normal images from one product category are available for training. We propose a single-class detector that asks what information one block can pass to another. We treat the depth of a frozen vision transformer as a sequence of discrete transitions. A directed predictor learns a block-to-block hidden-state transition pointwise over tokens. Adjacent-layer cosine similarity exposes four sharp fault lines in DINOv2 ViT-L, separating stable depth segments. The deepest blocks retain semantic context but lose local detail; a prediction from deep or shallow sources to sensitive targets therefore exposes the information that cannot be transported. The fault structure fixes the source and target roles, and the same rule transfers to ViT-B and RADIO-B. We use a bounded foreground prior calibrated solely on training images: it attenuates background evidence without also erasing defects outside the estimated foreground. Using one predictor architecture and a common training-only calibration protocol, image AUROC is 99.75 on MVTec-AD, 99.42 on VisA and 94.27 on Real-IAD. On Real-IAD the object-level AUROC is 96.26. At 256x256 pixel resolution, P-AUROC/P-AUPRO are 98.46/95.97 on MVTec-AD, 99.21/96.12 on VisA and 99.26/96.59 on Real-IAD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对无监督异常检测的过错- 指导性跨纬度预测
articles.content_zh: 特色重建在单级设置中被广泛用于无监督的工业异常检测,只有一类产品的正常图像可供培训使用. 我们提出一个单级探测器,它询问一个区块可以传递到另一个区块的信息. 我们把一个冷冻的视变器的深度当作一个离散的过渡序列. 一个定向的预测器会学习一个区块到区块的隐藏状态的过渡点,相对于符号. 相邻层余弦相似性在DINOv2 VIT-L中暴露出四条尖锐断层线,分离出稳定的深度段. 最深层的块保留语义上下文,但失去局部细节;从深层或浅层来源到敏感目标的预测因此暴露出无法传输的信息. 断层结构固定了源和目标角色,同样的规则也转移到了VIT-B和RADIO-B. 我们只使用训练图像上的定界前台:它削弱背景证据,而不同时消除估计前台外的缺陷。 使用一个预测器架构和一个普通的只训练校准协议,图像AUROC在MVTec-AD上是99.75,在VisA上是99.42,在Real-IAD上是94.27. 在Real-IAD上,天体级AUROC为96.26. 在256x256像素分辨率上,P-AUROC/P-AUPRO在MVTec-AD上是98.46/95.97,在VisA上是99.21/96.12,在Real-IAD上是99.26/96.59。

articles.title: Describe Your Facial Expressions by Linking Image Encoders and Large Language Models
articles.content: This paper presents a novel task of describing human facial expressions of a facial image in natural language, which captures the nuances of facial actions and emotional states beyond traditional emotion categories or facial action units (AUs). To achieve the facial expression captioning model, we propose a three-stage training framework that trains a vision-to-language model using synthesized image-text pairs and the BLIP-2 pre-training techniques. To overcome the challenge of missing training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a strategy that involves synthesizing and combining captions using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on either emotion categories or AUs. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating captions that describe details of facial actions and emotions, as well as the inferential relationship between them, even when those emotions are not present in the training data. It is also demonstrated that the vision-to-language task enhances the performance of the intermediate visual features on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过链接图像编码器和大语言模型来描述您的面部表达式
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的任务,用自然语言描述一个面部图像的人类面部表情,它捕捉了超越传统情感类别或面部动作单位(AUs)的面部动作和情感状态的细微差别. 为了实现面部表情字幕模型,我们提出一个三阶段培训框架,利用合成图像文本对和BLIP-2预训技术来训练一个视觉到语言模型. 为了克服缺少用于面部表情描述的训练图像文本对的挑战,我们提出了一个策略,即使用GPT-3.5和关于情感类别或非盟的现有说明来合成和合并标题。 实验证明了我们的方法在生成描述面部动作和情绪细节的字幕方面的有效性,以及它们之间的推论关系,即使这些情绪在训练数据中没有出现. 同时还表明,从视觉到语言的任务提高了中间视觉功能在非盟检测和情感分类任务上的性能。

articles.title: How Far Can Untrained Neural Networks Go in Anomaly Detection? From Tables to Pixels
articles.content: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. Notably, both models achieve these results without neural weight optimization or pretrained representations. A theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the Mahalanobis score gap, while empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability. These findings establish PRISM as both a competitive anomaly detector and a prior-to-learning baseline for assessing the added value of learned representations in anomaly detection.

articles.title_zh: 神经网络在异常检测中有多远? 从表格到像素
articles.content_zh: 异常检测(AD)往往被描述为一种表现学习问题,在这种情况下,强效预期需要学习的特征或针对AD的优化。 然而,这种观点可能忽略了异常现象与正常引用的内在分离性,即使没有学到的表述。 因此,我们调查未经训练的神经网络在异常检测中能走多远. 为此,我们提出PRISM,一个将固定随机非线性特征与正常参考的Mahalanobis评分相结合的框架,用于表格检测和密集的视觉局部化. 在亚行的47个表格数据集中,PRISM-T在比较方法中实现了最高的AUROC(86.4%)和第二高的AUPRC(65.9%)。 在MVTec AD和VisA上,包含27个视觉类,PRISM-V分别实现90.4%和96.4%的平均图像级和像素级的AUROC. 值得注意的是,这两个模型都实现了这些结果,没有进行神经重量优化或预先训练的表示. 一项理论分析进一步定性非线性转变如何影响对马哈拉诺比斯分数差距的平均值和共变性贡献,而经验分析则研究了由此产生的分数分离性. 这些调查结果将PRISM确定为一种竞争性异常探测器和在学习前评估在异常探测中学到的表述的附加值的基准。

articles.title: FreeOcc: Decoupling Ego-Motion for Efficient 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Continuous Flow Matching
articles.content: Current 4D occupancy world models use heavy cross-attention or deep recurrence to disentangle ego-motion from scene dynamics. This requires significant computational capacity. However, this effort is largely redundant since the ego-vehicle's intended future motion is provided by the downstream motion planner. We present FreeOcc, a lightweight continuous-time world model that introduces explicit $SE(2)$ geometric decoupling into a conditional flow-matching framework. By mathematically factoring out self-motion, we create a purely dynamic feature space. This space supports attention-free temporal fusion and allows physics-constrained ODEs to operate strictly on residual agent kinematics. To maximize deployment efficiency, FreeOcc introduces an uncertainty-aware blending mechanism. This routes well-observed voxels to a single-pass decoder, reserving the ODE solver exclusively for ambiguous, high-uncertainty regions. Requiring only 28.3M parameters-roughly 40% of comparable models-our optimal ensemble mode (FreeOcc-E) runs at 27 FPS. On nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance with a 0.47 m Near Field Chamfer Distance (NFCD) and 32.1% mIoU. Furthermore, the model transfers zero-shot to SemanticKITTI. It also proves highly robust, retaining 92.8% of its ideal mIoU under significant sensor packet loss and timestamp jitter.

articles.title_zh: FreeOcc:通过连续流量匹配实现高效4D占用预测的脱钩Ego-Motion
articles.content_zh: 目前的4D占用世界模型使用沉重的交叉注意力或深层重现,将自我运动与场景动态分开. 这需要很大的计算能力。 然而,这一努力在很大程度上是多余的,因为自负车辆打算的未来运动是由下游运动计划员提供的. 我们提出FreeOcc,一种轻量级连续世界模型,将明确的$SE(2)美元几何脱钩引入有条件的流量匹配框架. 通过数学上考虑自我运动,我们创造了一个纯粹动态的特征空间. 这个空间支持无注意力的时间聚变,并允许物理约束的ODE严格在残余物剂动能上运行. 为了最大限度地提高部署效率,FreeOcc引入了一种意识到不确定性的混合机制. 这条通向单一通道的解码器的防波索尔线,将ODE解码器专门留给模棱两可的高不确定性区域。 仅需要28.3M参数大致40%的可比较模型-我们的最佳组合模式(FreeOcc-E)运行于27 FPS. 在nuScenes上,FreeOcc以0.47米的近田Chamfer距离(NFCD)和32.1%的mIoU实现最先进的预测性能. 此外,该型号将零射入SemanticKITTI. 它还证明非常坚固,保留了92.8%的理想mIoU在重大传感器包丢失和时间戳热中。

articles.title: ProtoGestalt: Interpretable Prototypes for Facial Phenotyping and Diagnosis of Rare Genetic Disorders
articles.content: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.

articles.title_zh: 原型:可解释的稀有遗传病原型和诊断原型.
articles.content_zh: 罕见的遗传障碍因其多样性和重叠的临床特征而难以诊断. 面部形态学可以提供诊断线索,然而大多数诊断模型提供的可解释性有限,并非旨在支持对未诊断疾病的广泛筛查. 我们介绍ProtoGestalt, 一种可解释的原型框架, 用于面部麻黄,罕见病的筛查, 和综合症的识别。 该方法通过限制学习到的视觉特征来扩展原型学习,以选择面部区域,通过局部性和添加性的证据来解释预测. 我们评估ProtoGestalt在多个控制数据集和类流行值上区分合成与未受影响的面孔的能力. 我们进一步评价它在训练时观察到的 综合症的诊断性能 所学的原型表示法为合成图像和大小写匹配的控制图像提供了显著的分离,并随着控制比例的增加而保留了有用的性能. 该框架还显示出区分综合症的能力。 尽管已经存在合理准确的罕见病面部分类专业模型,但ProtoGestalt提供了一种可解释的替代方法,将预测与解剖有意义的面部区域联系起来,有可能支持临床决策,发现苯基基因关联.

articles.title: Reinforcing End-to-End Autonomous Driving Safety via Negative-Aware Planning in a Unified World-Action Model
articles.content: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future traffic states and driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. However, their action learning remains dominated by expert-trajectory imitation, leaving unsafe alternatives close to expert trajectories insufficiently constrained. To improve WAM robustness in safety-critical scenarios, we propose NegWAM, a safety post-training framework for unified WAMs that learns explicit safety boundaries from near-expert failure trajectories. NegWAM constructs negative trajectories that are geometrically close to the expert trajectory yet carry safety risks, uses them as repulsive anchors to steer predictions away from dangerous behavior, and encodes them as scene-conditioned rider tokens to learn scene--trajectory compatibility. During training, NegWAM jointly optimizes the flow-matching and near-expert negative objectives, while the auxiliary rider branch is discarded at inference, incurring no additional overhead. On NAVSIM v2, NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard, a 4.1% relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest. These results demonstrate that NegWAM achieves strong performance in safety-critical scenarios while preserving routine-driving performance. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further demonstrates cross-benchmark generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM.
