articles.title_zh: 通过世界统一行动模式中的消极意识规划加强端到端自主驾驶安全
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)联合模拟未来交通状态和驾驶行动,以便在智能交通系统中实现端到端的自主驾驶. 然而,他们的动作学习仍然以专家-弹射学模仿为主,使得接近专家轨迹的不安全替代品没有受到足够的制约. 为了提高WAM在安全关键情景中的稳健性,我们提议NegWAM,这是统一WAM的安全培训后框架,从近专家故障轨迹中吸取明确的安全界限。 NegWAM构造了几何接近专家轨迹但带有安全风险的负轨迹,用它们作为反推锚来引导预测远离危险行为,并将它们编码为场景条件的骑手标志,以学习场景-弹射兼容性. 在培训期间,NegWAM联合优化了流动匹配和近专家负面目标,而辅助骑手分支则被推论丢弃,不会引起额外的间接费用. 在NAVSIM v2上,NegWAM在Navhard上实现了40.4 EPDMS,比比较最强的无记分器WAM基线有4.1%的相对改进,在Navest上实现了93.3 EPDMS. 这些结果表明,NegWAM在安全关键情景下取得了强劲的性能,同时保持了例行驾驶性能. 对HUGSIM的零镜头闭路评价进一步展现了跨基准通用. 该代码可在https://github.com/Zizizizi-hao/NegWAM上查阅.

articles.title: Towards Practical 20 kbps Generative Video Compression via Adaptive Tokenization and Entropy Modeling
articles.content:
Video compression at ultra-low bitrates remains challenging due to the loss of perceptually important details under limited bit budgets. Recent generative video compression methods leverage pretrained video priors to improve perceptual quality and temporal coherence, but many follow a compress-then-generate paradigm, where generative priors are primarily exploited during reconstruction. Moreover, representations learned for generation and reconstruction are not inherently optimized for entropy coding.
  In this work, we propose \method, which adapts pretrained video representations into compression-oriented representations while preserving their reconstruction capability. Specifically, we adapt the pretrained causal video VAE of MiniMax-H3 into a discrete video tokenizer and develop a small autoregressive entropy model that captures local and global token dependencies, with grouped prediction for parallel decoding. To further improve coding efficiency, we jointly optimize the tokenizer and entropy model using a differentiable rate surrogate, allowing rate gradients to adapt token assignments toward lower coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC Class B demonstrate superior perceptual rate--distortion performance, achieving BD-LPIPS savings of 82.2\%--87.5\% and BD-DISTS savings of 78.3\%--85.0\% relative to GLC-Video.

articles.title_zh: 通过适应性切换和Entropy建模实现实用 20 kbps 基因视频压缩
articles.content_zh:
超低比特速率的视频压缩仍然具有挑战性,因为在有限的比特预算下失去了感知性重要的细节. 近期的基因视频压缩方法利用预先训练的视频前传,提高知觉质量和时间一致性,但很多都遵循了压缩-当时基因的范式,其中基因前传主要在重建期间被利用. 此外,为生成和重建所学得的表示法在本质上并没有被优化,以用于 en编码.
在这部作品中,我们提出\方法,它将经过预先训练的视频演示修改为面向压缩的演示,同时保留其重建能力. 具体地说,我们把MiniMax-H3的预训因果录影带VAE改编成离散录影带标注器,并开发出一个能捕捉局部和全球信物依赖性的小自旋式演算模型,并附有平行解码的分组预测. 为了进一步提高编码效率,我们联合优化了代码器和 en模型,使用一种不同速率的代码,使代码梯度能够使代码任务适应较低的编码成本,同时保持重建质量. 在UVG,MCL-JCV,HEVC Class B的实验中,表现出了优异的知觉率-扭曲性能,相对于GLC-Video,实现了BD-LPIPS的82.2\%-87.5\%和BD-DISTS的78.3\%-85.0\%.

articles.title: National-scale mapping of tree species composition in Switzerland from high-resolution aerial imagery and multimodal data
articles.content: Tree-species composition shapes forest productivity and how forests respond to climate disturbances such as drought, windthrow and insect outbreaks. Yet most national forest maps assign each pixel a single dominant species and cannot show the share of accompanying species. We mapped the basal-area shares of ten main tree species and a residual Other class across Switzerland at 30 m resolution. A deep-learning model combining 0.1 m aerial RGB imagery, airborne laser scanning (ALS), annual AlphaEarth satellite embeddings, and climate variables was trained on basal-area observations from 3,992 Swiss National Forest Inventory (NFI) sites. In spatial cross-validation, the model reached a macro-$R^2$ of 0.485 across the 11 classes. On an independent forest-reserve dataset, the map reached a macro-$R^2$ of 0.552 for individual 30 m pixels and 0.733 for plots, and identified the dominant class in 73.2% of pixels and 81.1% of plots. The map shows maple and ash as widespread minor components that dominant-class maps omit. It also reproduces the elevational sequence from broadleaved lowland stands through spruce to larch and Arolla pine near the treeline. By resolving the species mixture within each 30 m pixel, the map complements field inventory statistics with spatially continuous information that can support forest monitoring, the management of mixed stands, and climate-adaptation planning across Switzerland.

articles.title_zh: 瑞士通过高分辨率航空图像和多式联运数据对树种构成进行国家规模测绘
articles.content_zh: 树种组成决定了森林生产力,以及森林如何应对干旱、疏风和昆虫爆发等气候扰动。 然而,大多数国家的森林地图将每个像素指定为单一的主要物种,无法显示随附物种的份额。 我们绘制了10个主要树种和剩余树种的玄武岩区域份额 整个瑞士的其他班级 30 m 分辨率。 结合0.1米空中RGB图像、空中激光扫描(ALS)、每年的AlphaEarth卫星嵌入和气候变量的深层学习模型,从3,992个瑞士国家森林清单地点接受了关于玄武区观测的培训。 在空间交叉验证中,该模型在11个类别中达到了0.485美元的宏观汇率。 在一个独立的森林保留地数据集上,地图达到了一个30米像素的宏R^2美元和地块的0.552美元,并在73.2%的像素和81.1%的地块中确定了主导类. 地图显示枫和灰是主流类地图省略的广泛小组成部分。 它还从阔叶低地立体向树线附近的拉什和阿罗拉松复制高程序列。 该地图通过解决每30米像素内的物种混合物,以空间连续信息补充实地清单统计,从而支持森林监测、混合摊位管理和整个瑞士的气候适应规划。

articles.title: ATHAAR: A Medieval Scientific Arabic Manuscript Dataset for Handwritten Text Recognition
articles.content: Despite recent progress in handwritten text recognition, medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts remain an open challenge for current vision-language models (VLMs) due to cursive ligatures, variable diacritization, and more importantly the lack of training data. This paper aims to address this gap, by proposing the first annotation guidelines dedicated to the transcription of scientific Arabic manuscripts inspired by textual criticism, a well-established approach to historical text editing. We then propose, ATHAAR, a new dataset manually annotated following this guideline. Unlike previous resources in the field, ATHAAR varies both witnesses of the same text, calligraphic styles, and content to deal with texts but also numerals. Relying on state-of-the-art VLMs, we finally design a set of experiments to study models transfer across scripts, chapters, and treatises. Our findings highlight the limitations of current systems when faced with the specificities of ancient scientific texts.

articles.title_zh: ATHAAR:用于手写文字识别的中世纪科学阿拉伯语手写语言数据集
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在手写文字识别方面取得了进展,但中世纪的阿拉伯科学手稿仍然对当前视觉语言模型(VLMs)来说是一个公开的挑战,因为咒语结扎,可变的二化,更重要的是缺乏培训数据. 本文旨在弥补这一差距,提出第一个专门对受到文字批评的阿拉伯科学手稿进行抄录的说明准则,这是历史文字编辑的既定办法。 然后,我们提议,ATHAAR公司根据这项准则,采用人工附加说明的新数据集。 与之前的字段资源不同,ATHAAR既不同于同一文本的目击者,书法风格,也不同于处理文本的内容,但也不同于数字. 依靠最先进的VLM,我们最终设计了一套实验来研究跨脚本,章节和论文的模型转移. 我们的研究结果突出了在面对古代科学文本的特殊性时,现有系统的局限性。

articles.title: TerraMesh-Masks: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation for Earth Observation
articles.content: Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) enables models to segment a variety of concepts specified in natural language, removing the need for fixed label sets and fine-tuning. While recent OVS approaches have shown strong performance on natural images, they transfer poorly to Earth observation (EO) data due to differing semantics, scales, sensing modality, and geographic context. To date, large-scale EO-specific datasets and benchmarks for OVS remain scarce. We, therefore, introduce TerraMesh-Masks, a large-scale open-vocabulary segmentation dataset for EO, comprising 16 million binary masks aligned with nine million multimodal TerraMesh samples and annotated using OpenStreetMap and Overture-derived semantics. In addition, we provide an expert-reviewed evaluation set of 523 samples covering over 200 classes to enable robust evaluation. To demonstrate the impact of TerraMesh-Masks, we build an open-vocabulary version of TerraMind. Our results demonstrate significantly improved performance over general-purpose state-of-the-art models reaching 35.18% IoU versus 16.29% for DINOv3.txt and 11.33% for SAM-3. We release the dataset publicly under a permissive license at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-esa-geospatial/TerraMesh-Masks.

articles.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics-Aware Industrial Anomaly Detection and Reasoning
articles.content: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a long-established problem that aims to detect defects in industrial products during manufacturing for quality control. Most existing studies focus on static visual patterns as the basis for detection. However, in real manufacturing environments, many anomalies are dynamics-based, such as irregular movements that cannot be perceived from static cues alone. We observe that even recent Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approaches fall short in identifying such dynamic anomalies due to limited temporal modeling capability. To address this, we introduce MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a framework that equips MLLMs with fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics awareness for detecting and reasoning about dynamics-based defects. MUSTARD introduces optical-flow-guided keyframe selection and augmented modalities to capture critical motion irregularities through local motion patterns and global dynamic evolution. Its normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline requires only a few normal reference samples as the detection basis, avoiding any model updates. This enables efficient adaptation across various products and provides high decision interpretability. MUSTARD is the first MLLM-based framework for dynamics-based IAD. Experiments demonstrate its superior performance in detecting spatiotemporal anomalies and providing plausible explanations. The code will be made publicly available.

articles.title_zh: Spatiotemporal Dynamics- Aware 工业异常检测和推理
articles.content_zh: 工业异常检测(IAD)是一个长期存在的问题,旨在检测制造过程中用于质量控制的工业产品缺陷. 大多数现有的研究都以静态视觉模式作为检测的基础. 然而,在真实的制造环境中,许多异常现象都是基于动态的,例如不能仅从静态提示中看出的不规则移动. 我们注意到,即使是最近基于多式联运的大语言模型(MLLM)的方法,由于时间建模能力有限,也未能发现这种动态异常。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了MUSTARD:MUltimodule SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection,这个框架使MLLMs具备精细的振荡动态意识,用于探测和推理基于动态的缺陷. MUSTARD引入了光学流导键框选择和增强模式,通过局部运动模式和全球动态演化来捕捉关键运动异常. 其正常的基于模式的推理管道只需要几个正常的参考样本作为检测基础,避免任何模型更新. 这有助于在各种产品中进行有效的适应,并具有较高的决策解释性。 MUSTARD是第一个基于MLLM的基于动态的IAD框架. 实验证明它在检测瞬间异常和提供合理解释方面表现优异。 守则将公开发布。

articles.title: NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutrient Estimation with Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. Across all 96 configurations (4 datasets x 4 VLMs x 3 retrieval encoders x 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduced the primary estimation error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48). Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM--dataset pairs. For GPT-5.4-mini, under whole-meal prompting, the best-performing retrieval encoder for each dataset reduced the primary error on all four datasets relative to Vanilla, with reductions of 1.7--35.7%. Overall, our results show that grounding in multimodal exemplars comprising images and respective annotations can improve nutrient estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning, although the benefits remain configuration-dependent.

articles.title_zh: NutriVisRAG:利用远景-语言模型进行营养估计的多式联运实例
articles.content_zh: 饮食是健康的一个主要决定因素,然而,根据免费膳食图像进行准确的饮食评估仍然具有挑战性。 现有的基于检索的Visual-Langage Model(VLM)的营养素估计方法通常依赖于文字食物表示,而据我们所知,没有调查直接基于视觉上类似的附加说明的餐食。 我们提出Nutri VisRAG,这是一个回收增强的生成框架,它使用一个视觉编码器来取回有已知营养说明的类似膳食,并作为在推论时间对VLM营养素进行估算的多模式内附实例提供,而不进行特定任务的微调。 我们评价Nutri VisRAG的四套数据、四套VLM数据、三套检索编码器和两套促动策略,包括用胰岛素治疗糖尿病的成年人的免费膳食,将碳水化合物估计数与两位饮食学家的说明进行比较。 在所有96个配置(4个数据集x4个VLMx3个检索编码器x2个提示策略)中,NutriVisRAG减少了56个主估计误差,全米(35/48)下改进的频率高于每个项目提示(21/48)。 在整个评估的配置中,最低的NutriVisRAG误差低于16对VLM-数据集中13对最佳的Vanilla误差. 对GPT-5.4-mini来说,在全餐提示下,每个数据集最有性能的检索编码器会减少所有四个数据集相对于香草的主要错误,减少1.7-35.7%. 总体而言,我们的结果表明,在包含图像和相应说明的多式联运范例中扎根,可以改进推断时的养分估计,而无需对具体任务进行微调,尽管效益仍然取决于配置。

articles.title: Deformable Contact-Aware 3D Object Placement
articles.content: Current language-guided 3D object placement typically predicts a rigid 6-DoF pose, ignoring the physical reality that indoor placements are dictated by contact. Consequently, predicted poses often float, interpenetrate supports, or fail to deform soft surfaces. We propose Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP), a framework that reframes placement as a drop-to-equilibrium process. Rather than predicting a static pose, DCAP constructs a semantic release state that specifies the drop location, object scale, and deformable components, allowing a coupled rigid-deformable simulator to settle the object under gravity and friction. This explicitly separates semantic intent from physical realization. Evaluated on a benchmark of 2,063 prompt-asset-scene cases, DCAP significantly outperforms static baselines. On standard placements, it improves VLM Physics & Naturalness by 21.2 points and human preference by 26.5 points over the strongest raw rigid baseline, while reducing mean penetration depth by 72.3%. Compared to simulated rollout baselines, DCAP reduces residual speed by 72.1%. Ultimately, our results prove that physically accurate 3D placement requires modeling semantic intent and physical realization as strictly separate processes.

articles.title_zh: 可变形的联系人- 软件 3D 对象放置
articles.content_zh: 当前语言制导的3D对象布置一般预测一个刚性6-DoF的姿势,忽略了室内布置由接触决定的物理现实. 因此,预测的姿势往往漂浮、穿透式支持或无法变形软表面。 我们提议采用可变形的接触-智能定位(DCAP),这个框架将定位重新设定为滴到平衡过程。 DCAP不是预测静止的姿势,而是构建一个语义释放状态,指定了落地位置,物体尺度,以及可变构件,允许结合刚性-可变构模拟器在重力和摩擦下对物体进行定点. 这明确将语义意图与物理实现区分开来. 根据2,063个即时资产-场景的基准评估,反腐败司的业绩大大高于静态基线。 在标准布置上,它将VLM物理和自然学提高21.2分,人类偏好比最强的原始刚性基线提高26.5分,同时将平均渗透深度降低72.3. 与模拟推出基线相比,DCAP将剩余速度降低了72.1%. 归根结底,我们的结果证明,在物理上准确的3D放置需要将语义意图和物理实现作为严格独立的过程进行模型化.

articles.title: When GeoFMs Meet VHR: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Very High Resolution Earth Observation Imagery
articles.content: Geospatial foundation models are a widely adopted starting point for remote sensing tasks. Most are pretrained on Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. Many applications instead rely on very high resolution (VHR) imagery, where individual buildings, roads, and amenities are resolved. We study which pretraining regimes transfer well to this scale. We introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark suite of ten datasets at 1.5m GSD or finer spanning five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. We evaluate twelve encoders in three pretraining tiers with frozen backbones at two training-data fractions. We find that both pretraining on large natural-image collections and VHR-specific pretraining transfer effectively to VHR tasks, with complementary strengths. SkySense leads when labels are scarce; at the full label fraction the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L edges ahead, with the two close together there. Encoders pretrained only on Sentinel-scale imagery transfer least well under RGB input. Guided by these complementary results, we continue the self-supervised pretraining of DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million held-out VHR tiles and evaluate the resulting encoder without changing the downstream protocol. The continued model gives a clear improvement over the released backbone when labels are scarce and a modest one at the full fraction, at no increase in inference parameters or compute. These findings support a generalize-then-specialize strategy: already strong, broad natural-image pretraining can be further improved by a short VHR continuation stage while preserving its general visual features.

articles.title_zh: GeoFMs 满足 VHR: 甚高分辨率地球观测基准基础模型 图像
articles.content_zh: 地理空间基础模型是广泛采用的遥感任务的起点。 大部分在Sentinel-1/2和Landsat图像上预先训练,地面取样距离为10米或较宽。 许多应用依赖于高分辨率的图像,其中解决了单个建筑物、道路和设施。 我们研究哪些预先训练制度能很好地达到这个规模。 我们引入了VHR-Bench, 由10个数据集组成的基准套件, 150米 GSD或更精细,涵盖五个任务领域、八个应用领域以及卫星和航空平台。 我们评估了12个编码器 分三个预训级别 并用冷冻的骨干 分两个培训数据部分 我们发现,对大型自然图像收集的预训和针对VHR的预训转移都有效用于VHR任务,具有互补的优势. SkySense在标签稀缺时会领先;在完整标签时会分辨出网络预训的DINOv3 VIT-L边缘前方,两边并存在那里. 编码器只在Sentinel规模的图像上预训,在RGB输入下传输得最少. 以这些互补结果为指导,我们继续自行监督DINov3 VIT-L对102万块持有的VHR瓷砖进行预训,并在不改变下游协议的情况下评价由此产生的编码器. 持续型号在标签稀缺,且完整分量适度,不增加推论参数或计算时,会比释放的骨干有明显的改进. 这些调查结果支持一种普遍化的、当时具有专门性的战略:已经很强的、广泛的自然成像预训可以通过一个简短的VHR延续阶段来进一步改进,同时保留其一般的视觉特征。

articles.title: Reviving the Discarded High-Resolution Feature for Transformer-Based Tiny Object Detection
articles.content: Tiny object detection remains challenging because tiny instances occupy only a few pixels, and their fine-grained details are easily lost during feature downsampling. Although the highest-resolution feature preserves rich local details for tiny objects, DETR-like detectors often discard it due to its large computational cost, while directly reintroducing this feature also brings dense background noise. To address this problem, we propose ReDHF, a novel framework that Revives the Discarded High-resolution Feature for tiny object detection. ReDHF has three cooperative components. Cross-Scale Deformable Fusion (CSDF) first constructs a semantically enhanced highest-resolution feature and injects its fine-grained details into the shallow feature under a moderate cost. Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision (EGSS) then guides the enhanced feature to learn more reliable classification and localization priors by applying geometry-adaptive auxiliary supervision. Full-Scale Query Interaction (FSQI) further enables decoder queries to access both low-level details and high-level semantic information, allowing them to aggregate richer cues for tiny objects. Extensive experiments show that ReDHF consistently improves multiple baselines across different DETR variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the evaluated benchmarks. The best ReDHF variants surpass their baselines by +1.4 AP on AI-TOD-v2, +1.6 AP on VisDrone, and +1.5 AP on SODA-D, with especially notable gains on tiny and small objects.

articles.title_zh: 恢复用于基于变形器的微小对象检测的弃置高分辨率特性
articles.content_zh: 细小的物体探测仍然具有挑战性,因为细小的事件只占据了少数像素,在特征下取样时,它们细微的纹理细节很容易丢失. 虽然最高分辨率的特性为细小物体保留了丰富的局部细节,但类似DETR的探测器经常因为巨大的计算成本而丢弃它,而直接重新引入这个特性也会带来密集的背景噪声. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出ReDHF,这个新颖的框架,将弃置的高分辨率特性用于微小物体的探测. REDHF有三个合作部分. 跨尺度变形融合(CSDF)首先构筑了精密增强的最高分辨率特征,并以中度成本将其精细细节注入浅层特征. 椭圆-guided Shallow监管(EGSS)然后通过应用几何适应辅助监管来指导增强的特征,以学习更可靠的分类和本地化前科. 全程查询交互(FSQI)进一步使解码器查询既可以访问低级细节,又可以访问高级语义信息,使得它们可以将更丰富的提示集合到微小对象上. 广泛的实验表明,REDHF不断改进不同DETR变体的多个基线,并实现评价基准的最新性能. 最好的ReDHF变体在AI-TOD-v2,+1.6 AP在VisDrone,+1.5 AP在SODA-D上超过了它们的基线,在微小物体上特别显著的收获.

articles.title: Bri3D: Bridging the Object-Scene Gap in Single-Image 3D Generation via Scene-Anchor
articles.content: Generating compositional 3D scenes from a single image requires recovering detailed object geometry and coherent spatial arrangements. Existing object-to-scene methods, including SAM3D and MIDI, extend object generation through image-context reasoning or inter-instance modeling. Coordinating objects remains challenging with limited scene-level supervision. Directly extending object-centric generators to entire scenes can degrade geometry and fail to preserve instance scale, orientation, and pose. We propose Bri3D, a framework bridging scene-level structural reasoning and object-level generative priors through instance-aware voxel scene anchors. Bri3D predicts a color-coded scene scaffold encoding coarse object geometry and spatial arrangements. Each instance is extracted as a scene anchor and refined into a pose-preserving, prior-compatible voxel support, enabling a frozen object generator to synthesize detailed textured geometry in the anchor-defined spatial reference. This coarse-to-fine design separates scene organization from object-scale detail synthesis, focusing scene-level training on spatial organization and anchor refinement while reusing pretrained object priors. Experiments demonstrate improvements in scene layout, object geometry, visual quality, and generalization. Bri3D predicts scene layouts efficiently; full scene generation is faster than SceneGen and SAM3D.

articles.title_zh: Bri3D:通过Scene-Anchor在单图像 3D 生成中缩小对象-场面差距
articles.content_zh: 从单一图像中生成构成的3D场景需要恢复详细的物体几何和连贯的空间安排. 包括SAM3D和MIDI在内的现有对象对场方法通过图像-文本推理或内置模型扩展对象生成. 在有限的场景一级监督下,协调对象仍然具有挑战性。 将以物体为中心的发电机直接延伸至整个场景,可以降解几何,无法保存实例尺度、方向和姿势。 我们提出Bri3D,一个框架 连接场景层次的结构推理 和对象层次 基因前科 通过实例意识 voxel 场景锚。 Bri3D预测一个彩色编码的场景脚手脚编码粗细的物体几何和空间安排. 每个实例都作为场景锚地提取,并被精炼成一个姿势保留,前相兼容的阴道支持,使一个被冻结的物体生成器能够在锚地定义的空间参考物中合成详细的纹理几何. 这种粗细到精细的设计将场景组织与物体尺度细节合成区分开来,将场景层面的空间组织培训和锚定精细化作为重点,同时重新使用预先训练过的物体前身. 实验显示在场景布局,物体几何,视觉质量,以及概括等方面都有改进. Bri3D预测场景布局高效;完整的场景生成速度比SceneGen和SAM3D快.

articles.title: Rotation Is Token-Blind: A Structural Criterion for Post-Training Quantization of Feed-Forward Geometry Transformers
articles.content: Feed-forward 3D models use Transformers to predict camera poses, depth, and structure in one pass, avoiding iterative multi-view optimization. Long sequences and deep attention incur high compute and memory costs, motivating Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) for deployment. Existing PTQ methods mainly suppress channel-wise outliers by smoothing or orthogonal rotation. Geometry Transformers introduce a different challenge: heterogeneous token types share one activation quantization grid. A few special tokens may exert high leverage over global outputs and be updated by only a subset of blocks. Token-blind transforms, which apply the same transformation to every token, reduce overall quantization error but cannot remove differentiated degradation across token types. We propose QMapAnything, a structure-aware PTQ framework. We cast floating-point-preserving rotation and smoothing as a token-blind reparameterization group, and prove that they yield common-mode gains while leaving relative token SNR unchanged. We introduce a statistic $Γ$ that combines a special token's quantization disadvantage and output leverage to predict whether differentiated bias correction is needed beyond rotation. Experiments on geometric benchmarks show that W4A8 closely matches full-precision performance. Under W8A8, peak memory falls by $2.2$--$3.1\times$ versus FP32, with up to $3.1\times$ speedup on real hardware. These results provide a principled and efficient approach to deploying feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in resource-constrained edges.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 旋转是Token-Blind:用于Feed-Forward几何变形器的训练后量化的结构标准
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 3D模型使用变形器在一次通过中预测相机的姿势,深度,结构,避免迭代多视图优化. 长时间的序列和深度的注意需要高昂的计算和内存成本,促使训练后量化(PTQ)进行部署. 现有的PTQ方法主要通过平滑或正交旋转来压制信道的偏转器. 几何变形器引入了不同的挑战:多种符号类型共享一个激活量化网格. 少数特殊标志可能对全球产出产生很大影响,仅通过一组区块加以更新。 Token-blind变换,将相同的变换应用到每一个符,减少整体的量化错误,但不能消除各种符号类型的不同降解. 我们提出QMapAnything,一个结构意识的PTQ框架. 我们把浮点保持旋转和平滑作为标志性盲光再参数化组,并证明它们能产生共同模式收益,同时保持相对符号SNR不变。 我们采用了一种统计性美元,将特殊标志的量化劣势和产出杠杆结合起来,预测在轮换之外是否需要有区别的偏差纠正。 对几何基准的实验表明,W4A8与全精度性能紧密匹配. 在W8A8下,峰值内存与FP32相比下降了2.2美元-3.1美元/时,实际硬件的速率高达3.1美元/时. 这些成果为在受资源制约的边缘地区部署向前进的三维重建模式提供了一个原则性和高效率的方法。

articles.title: Leakage- and Label-Aware Benchmarking of Class-Imbalance Strategies for Multimodal Chest X-Ray and EHR Classification
articles.content: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. Third, under patient-separated evaluation with admission-aligned and rule-refined labels, the initial conclusions do not hold: in the evaluated configurations no imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 over no augmentation by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and the released EHR variables stayed at the level of the all-positive baseline, whereas the diagnostic history available at imaging time and image embeddings exceeded it, including, with rule-refined labels, a CheXpert-trained encoder that never saw these radiographs; RAD-DINO had seen 96.6% of them during self-supervised pretraining. Adding either encoder to the diagnostic history gave no statistically significant F2 gain; exploratory AUROC gains were significant with RAD-DINO but not with DenseNet. We provide reusable diagnostics, a leakage-aware protocol and a checklist.

articles.title_zh: 采用多式胸X射线和EHR分类的班级平衡战略基准化
articles.content_zh: 对多式胸X射线(CXR)和电子健康记录预测的班级平衡战略基准,往往在记录级别分组中加以评价,其中一名病人提供几幅放射图。 我们对有8个诊断目标的10 479名病人的29 083幅MIMIC-CXR放射图进行了这一基准审计。 首先,分录基准有误导性:一个检索表复制了同一种EHR矢量的开发套射线图的标签,几乎与最佳模型相符,在看不见的病人身上,每个模型都降到了预测每个病例阳性的水平。 第二,将标签追溯回MIMIC-IV,解释了为什么:每个病人的标签是单次录入的诊断代码上的关键词匹配,复制,每个病人有一个EHR矢量,到所有病人的放射图上,因此大约三分之一的放射图上带有与自己录入的代码不同的标签. 第三,在患者与患者分开的评估中,加上符合录取要求和完善规则的标签,初步结论并不认为:在评估的配置中,没有不平衡战略将观察到的平均值F2提高到不超过0.01, 调制的树木组合与调制的物流回归相比没有一致的优势,所释放的EHR变量停留在全阳性基线的水平上,而成像时间和图像嵌入的诊断历史超过了这一水平,包括使用改进规则的标签,一个从未见过这些无线电图的CheXpert训练编码器;RAD-DINO在自我监督的预先训练中曾见过96.6%。 在诊断史上添加编码器或编码器,在统计学上没有带来显著的F2收益;探索性的AUROC收益在RAD-DINO方面是显著的,但在DenseNet方面则不是显著的。 我们提供可重复使用的诊断、渗漏意识协议和核对表。

articles.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
articles.content: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.

articles.title_zh: 科学家世界:发展AI-科学家研究世界
articles.content_zh: AI-Scientists来了,但他们成长的世界却没有。 人类科学家理所当然地认为,他们在科学文献中等待着几个世纪的公开问题和共同的想法。 对AI-科学家来说,世界是可读的,但不可运行的,因此我们为他们建设科学家世界:每篇研究论文都成为可执行的环境. 我们的自主管道摘录每篇论文的不限名额的研究问题,并转载其拟议方法作为基线;一位进入环境的AI-科学家根据人类作者的成就进行评估. 我们释放了首批1000个经过验证的环境. 以世界为评价,我们发现前沿AI科学家已经超过了人类研究人员的74%的时间. 作为AI如何进行科学的纪录,它包含了6400小时的研究痕迹,每个想法,实验,失败,以及成功. 作为一个训练场,我们能够提升(+158%)一个小模型,以配合研究思想中的前沿模型. 终于,AI-Scientists自己的世界已经到来,从科学本身中成长和成长.

articles.title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher's per-token supervision. Does this dense signal reduce the training FLOPs needed to reach a target accuracy compared with reinforcement learning? We systematically compare vanilla reverse-KL OPD with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across task difficulty, student and teacher size, domain, and optimization choices, measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs. With an external post-trained teacher, OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP at matched settings, even when the teacher is further trained with GRPO, and often suffers response-length inflation. Yet a different teacher changes the picture: when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's accuracy on math with $50\times$ fewer distillation FLOPs than GRPO needs to reach the same accuracy. Following the same teacher setting, we consistently observe this high efficiency with a larger student, on code, and in a second model family. On a single domain, however, the GRPO checkpoint is already the desired model, so distilling it adds to total compute. Across domains, separate GRPO checkpoints hold different capabilities, and no single checkpoint serves every domain. Multi-teacher OPD (DeepSeek-AI, 2026) consolidates per-domain GRPO experts into a single student that matches each expert's accuracy, with the distillation stage costing only 5.2% (on 2 domains) and 8.0% (on 4 domains) of the specialist training FLOPs. Counting specialist training and distillation together, this pipeline reaches joint GRPO's performance on the 2-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.

articles.title_zh: 解除对GRPO的计算效率
articles.content_zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)在被冷冻的老师的每个托肯监督下,对学生进行自己的推广培训. 与强化学习相比,这种密集信号是否减少了达到目标精确度所需的FLOP培训? 我们系统地将香草反 KL OPD 和 Group 相对政策优化(GRPO) 相比较,涵盖任务难度,师生规模,领域,以及优化选择,对照培训 FLOP 衡量被搁置的准确性. 有了受过外部培训的教师,OPD通常在相应的环境下,每次培训FLOP的准确性都会输给GRPO,即使教师接受GRPO的进一步培训,而且经常会遭受响应长度的通货膨胀. 然而不同的老师改变了画面:当老师是学生自己的GRPO检查站时,OPD以50美元比GRPO所需的蒸馏FLOP少50美元来恢复该检查站的数学精度. 遵循同样的教师环境,我们一直与一个较大的学生,在代码上,在第二个模范家庭中,观察到这种高效益. 然而在单一领域,GRPO检查站已经是理想的模式,因此蒸馏会增加总计算. 在各个领域,单独的GRPO检查站具有不同的能力,没有单一的检查站为每个领域服务。 多教师OPD(DeepSeek-AI,2026年)将每个领域的GRPO专家合并为一个符合每个专家准确度的单一学生,蒸馏阶段的成本仅为专业培训FLOP的5.2%(在2个领域)和8.0%(在4个领域)。 在计算专家培训和蒸馏时,这一管道在2个领域组合上达到了联合GRPO的性能,减少了42.0%的FLOP总量.

articles.title: Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes
articles.content: Typed-decision models score options that the caller supplies at request time, so their accuracy depends on label wording that the model's developer does not control. We compare two releases of a 307M-parameter multilingual cross-encoder, Ru-Jev, trained on thirteen Russian-language tasks; the later release adds an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms. Holding questions fixed and varying only how eighteen routing labels are worded, we evaluate ten label vocabularies, produced by three separate processes and checked for overlap with the training data, with five candidates per question and, for eight of them, also with eighteen. On held-out vocabularies made of ordinary or borrowed words (English-derived jargon, office slang, department names), the augmented release is more accurate in every setting, by up to 0.24. Eleven of these fourteen gains survive a Holm correction (slang with eighteen candidates and descriptive sentences with five do not), and for jargon on all labels the label-level interval excludes zero in both settings. On abbreviations and opaque codes it gives no usable gain: on abbreviations it is not better, and worse on the clean slice, and on opaque codes both releases stay at or below chance once labels related to training options are removed. In most cells where accuracy rises, the risk-coverage area falls, but with eighteen candidates confident errors rise on jargon and slang. On two datasets neither release saw, accuracy moves by -8.4 and +5.6 points. We also report four evaluation hazards from comparing the two releases.

articles.title_zh: 在打字决定中加注标签 编码器: unfamiliar words, 而不是缩写或代码上的增益
articles.content_zh: 型号决定模型对调用者在请求时间提供的选项进行评分,因此其准确性取决于该模型的开发者不控制的标签措辞. 我们比较了两个版本,一个307M参数的多语言交叉编码器Ru-Jev,经过了13个俄语任务的培训;后来的版本增加了一个增量,呈现了几种表面形式的标签. 我们持有的问题只有固定和不同的18个路由标签,我们评价10个路由词汇,由三个不同的程序制作,并核对与培训数据的重叠,每个问题有5名候选人,其中8名还有18名候选人。 在用普通或借词(英语衍生的词汇、办公室名、部门名)制作的搁置词汇表上,增加的发布在每个场合都更准确,最多0.24. 在这14项收益中,有11项在Holm更正后幸存下来(有18个候选者,有5个没有的描述性句子),对于所有标签上的术语,标签级别间隔排除了两种设置中的0。 在缩略语和不透明代码上,它不会产生有用的收益:在缩略语上,它并不更好,在干净的片子上更糟糕;在不透明代码上,一旦与培训选项有关的标签被删除,那么释放就会处于或低于机会。 在精度上升的大多数细胞中,风险覆盖面积下降,但随着18名候选人的自信错误在词汇和词典上上升. 在两个数据集上,没有看到释放,准确度移动至-8.4和+5.6点。 我们还报告通过比较这两个释放物对四种评估危害。

articles.title: Understanding AI from the Inside: The State of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety
articles.content: Neural networks are likely to be among the most consequential artefacts in human history. As these systems become more capable and autonomous, their potential to cause societal harm also grows, making AI safety one of the defining challenges of our time. Yet we continue to build increasingly powerful systems without fully understanding how they work, how they will behave in unfamiliar situations, or how to reliably control them. Mechanistic interpretability offers a path towards understanding these systems by studying their internal representations and computations, with the aim of evaluating, predicting, and controlling behaviour. We survey mechanistic interpretability for AI safety in order to answer the question: Does understanding how models work actually make them safer? We place mechanistic interpretability in the broader context of interpretability research and compare its mechanistic evidence with behavioural evaluation. We introduce the foundations of mechanistic interpretability, including features, polysemanticity, transformer computation, and circuits, and survey methods for feature extraction and analysis, circuit discovery and causal verification, explaining intermediate representations in natural language, learning dynamics, and training-data attribution. Beyond surveying existing methods, we propose a unified framework for evaluating mechanistic interpretability claims and characterise six research orientations by their goals, assumptions, and trade-offs. Finally, we examine how mechanistic understanding can support AI safety, including knowledge editing, steering, and monitoring, and assess its limitations, failure modes, open problems, and relationship to behavioural safety measures. We also release a repository of code notebooks with worked examples that reproduce key findings from surveyed methods, allowing readers to build intuition through hands-on experimentation.

articles.title_zh: 从内部了解大赦国际:对大赦国际安全的机械解释
articles.content_zh: 神经网络很可能是人类历史上影响最大的手工艺品。 随着这些系统的能力和自主性提高,它们造成社会损害的潜力也越来越大,从而使AI安全成为我们时代的决定性挑战之一。 然而,我们继续建立日益强大的系统,却没有充分了解它们是如何运作的,它们如何在不熟悉的情况下行事,或如何可靠地控制它们。 机械解释性通过研究其内部表述和计算,为了解这些系统提供了一条道路,目的是评价、预测和控制行为。 我们调查人工智能安全的机械解释性,以回答问题: 了解模型是如何工作的吗? 我们把机械解释性放在广义的解释性研究的背景下,并将其机械证据与行为评价进行比较. 我们提出机械解释的基础,包括特征、多聚体、变压器计算和电路,以及特征提取和分析、电路发现和因果核查的调查方法,解释自然语言的中间表述、学习动态以及培训数据归属。 除了调查现有方法外,我们建议建立一个统一的框架,用以评价机械解释性主张,并按其目标、假设和取舍确定六个研究方向。 最后,我们审查机械理解如何支持人工智能安全,包括知识编辑、指导和监测,并评估其局限性、故障模式、公开问题以及与行为安全措施的关系。 我们还发布了一个密码笔记本的存储库,其中有工作的例子,复制了调查方法的关键发现,使读者能够通过亲身实验建立直觉.

articles.title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
articles.content: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.

articles.title_zh: MedGraph:为长期医学对话保持病人状态和图记忆
articles.content_zh: 以LLM为基础的医疗助理随患者过访需要记忆,随着患者临床状态的变化,保持其正确性. 我们在纵向医学对话中检查了五个记忆系统的错误,并发现了三个反复出现的原因:检索到的证据给出了过时的状态,包括了他人的健康事实,或者缺乏答案所依赖的安全事实. 我们介绍MedGraph,一个为这三件案子建造的图记. 建筑提取的每场会议的事实,将每个事实归结于其所描述的人,并将药物、诊断和测量记录与保持早期状态的链条联系起来。 检索将患者的链条排成单元,在提问时读取每个链条,并添加原始对话文本;患者简介列出每个记录的安全事实和每个问题. 在MedMemory Bench上,MedGraph以GPT和Quen两个骨干都具有最高的整体精度,在5个基线中最强的上方有10.5和10.4分,在GPT环境下高效的内存构造和应答.

articles.title: StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
articles.content: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. In addition, by nature, StepBack can be combined with adaptive inference methods such as Adaptive Consistency, further improving their inference-time efficiency.

articles.title_zh: StepBack: 步骤级错误- 本地化重样以高效测试- 时间原因
articles.content_zh: 自我一致性(SC)是一种被广泛使用的用于改进思维链推理的解码策略,但它需要用预先设定的预算来取样许多完整的推理轨迹. 其高效的变体主要通过提前停止全轨采样或将样本数量分散到各个问题来降低成本. 在本文中,我们提出了StepBack,一种步级误差本地化的重样方法,用于高效的测试时间推理. 考虑到少量的草稿轨迹,StepBack使用轻量级信号将可能的第一个错误位置本地化,然后重新标出检测到的错误步骤及其后缀,然后多数回答投票. 经验中,StepBack在7个数学推理和多跳QA基准中平均匹配SC的精度,同时将符号使用率减少高达41.26%. 此外,从性质上讲,StepBack可以与适应性一致性等适应性推论方法结合,进一步提高其推论时间效率.

articles.title: SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains
articles.content: Masked diffusion language models offer parallel text generation, but independently sampling multiple tokens can disrupt their dependencies and change the output distribution. Exact continuous-time sampling avoids this approximation, yet typically requires one sequential model evaluation per token. We introduce SpecCTMC, a training-free speculative sampler that reduces this sequential bottleneck without a separate draft model. SpecCTMC proposes successive token updates using previously computed model predictions, evaluates their intermediate states in parallel, and applies an exact acceptance-and-correction procedure. We prove that SpecCTMC preserves the joint distribution of event times, generation order, and token values of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain. It therefore introduces neither time-discretization error nor additional factorization error from parallel decoding. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across five benchmarks demonstrate 1.73-4.38x fewer sequential model evaluations than direct continuous-time sampling, while preserving the reference sampling distribution. Our code is available at: https://github.com/kasakh/specctmc
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpecCTMC:精确的分光语言模拟模型连续时间马尔科夫链
articles.content_zh: 蒙面扩散语言模型提供并行的文本生成,但独立地取样多个符号可以破坏它们的依赖性,改变输出分布. 精确的连续时间采样避免了这种近似现象,但通常需要每个符号一个顺序模型评价. 我们引进了SpecCTMC, 一个没有训练的投机性采样器, 减少这种连续的瓶颈, 没有单独的模型草稿。 SpecCTMC采用之前计算过的模型预测,连续提出符号更新,同时评价其中间状态,并采用精确的接受和校正程序. 我们证明SpecCTMC保留了事件时间的联合分布,生成顺序,以及基础连续时间马尔科夫链的象征值. 因此,它既不引入时间分解错误,也不引入平行解码的额外要素化错误. 关于LLaDA-8B-指示和Dream-v0-指示7B的五个基准实验显示,相继进行的模型评价比直接连续取样少1.73-4.38x,同时保留了参考抽样分布。 我们的代码见:https://github.com/kasakh/spectmc。

articles.title: Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions
articles.content: Much of human culture is tacit and is typically learned through situated social interaction. As LLMs are deployed as interactive agents across diverse communities, assessing their cultural competence demands moving beyond existing question-answering approaches, shifting from what they know to how they adapt. In this work, we broaden the scope of cultural adaptation in NLP by investigating whether LLMs can adapt through repeated interactions via a sandbox environment. By reframing cultural adaptation as a continuous process of norm assimilation through social interaction, our work demonstrates that memory mechanisms foster longitudinal learning across repeated interactions, facilitate transfer to different social settings, and enable multilingual norm assimilation across five languages. Together, our findings lay the groundwork for continuous, interaction-driven cultural adaptation in LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 反复的社会互动中的文化适应
articles.content_zh: 许多人类文化是隐性文化,通常通过定位的社会互动来学习。 由于法学硕士作为互动代理人被部署到不同社区,评估其文化能力要求超越现有的问答方法,从所了解的转向如何适应。 在这项工作中,我们通过调查LLMS是否可以通过沙盒环境的反复互动来适应,从而拓宽了NLP的文化适应范围. 通过通过社会互动将文化适应重新定位为规范同化的连续过程,我们的工作表明,记忆机制促进反复互动的纵向学习,促进向不同社会环境的转移,并促成五种语言的多语种规范同化。 我们的调查结果共同为长期、互动驱动的文化适应工作奠定了基础。

articles.title: Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation
articles.content: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. The second, Contrastive-MTL, provides implicit syntactic guidance through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism, without requiring explicit label prediction. Both rely on syntactic annotations during training and eliminate need for hand-crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference. We evaluate eleven datasets spanning seven languages---the MARC corpus (English, Spanish, French, German) and seven datasets from SemEval-2022 Task 10 (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, Catalan)---using four established SEL encodings. With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms a syntax-naive baseline on 10 of 11 datasets and surpasses the external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that parses at inference on all six datasets where the latter applies, while being 1.5--9$\times$ faster at evaluation. Standard-MTL is more dataset- and encoding-dependent. These results show implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed explicit parsing at inference without computational overhead.

articles.title_zh: 具有多任务学习语法增强的极性分类
articles.content_zh: 感知分析(SA)是NLP的一项基本任务,涉及文本中主观信息的识别和分类. 虽然基于词汇的方法提供了透明度,但它们往往与否定和强化等语言现象作斗争。 为解决这一问题,将协同剖析纳入SA管道,但常规剖析器引入了重大的计算间接费用。 最近的工作显示,将依赖性重新定位为序列标签(SEL)任务可以提高效率。 我们提出和比较两个策略,将综合知识纳入统一多任务学习(MTL)下的神经情绪分析模型. 第一种是标准-MTL,联合学习依赖解析(通过序列标签)和情感极性分类,使用一个共享编码器,其中有两个任务特定头. 第二部"Contrastive-MTL"通过对比性辅助目标和语法偏差的注意力集合机制提供隐含的合成指导,而不需要明确的标签预测. 两者在训练期间都依赖综合说明,并消除了手动编译规则或外部解析推论的需要. 我们评价了11个涵盖7种语言的数据集——MARCecurity(英语,西班牙语,法语,德语)和来自SemEval-2022 Status 10(英语,西班牙语,挪威语,巴斯克语,加泰罗尼亚语)的7个数据集——使用四种既定的SEL编码. 由于相对编码,Contrastive-MTL在11个数据集中的10个数据集上超过了语法负基准,并超越了外部基于规则的管道(SELSP),该管道对后者适用的所有6个数据集进行推论,而评价速度则更快,为1.5-9美元\时间. 标准-MTL更依赖数据集和编码. 这些结果表明,在培训期间进行隐含的合成监督可以匹配或超过明确的推断,而无需计算间接费用。

articles.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.

articles.title_zh: 不同认知和生物医学知识图的大型语言模型基准:图表定位在多功能理性和致幻减缓中的作用
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于生物医学和认知神经科学,但是其可靠地推理的能力超过多样的知识图(KGs)仍然不清楚. 我们以5个LLM(GPT-5.1,双子座2.0 Pro,Llama 3,Quen,和BioGPT)为基准,涵盖5个KG:DrugBank,神经合成,认知图集,脑图,和GDPKG. 我们引入了一个多层次的查询数据集,以评价在KG-aware(基于图形)和KG-不可知条件下的推理深度和事实准确性. 说明人之间的协议是实质性的,科恩的卡帕为0.781(范围:0.753-0.807),弗莱斯的卡帕为0.77. 结果显示,通用模型,特别是GPT-5.1和双子座2.0 Pro,在多跳和高层次推理任务上一般都优于特定域模型,尽管随着查询复杂性的增加,性能下降. KG定位降低了所有评估模型的幻觉率。 与我们最初的假设相反,专有域模型在专门任务上不连贯地超过通用模型,而不以图表为基础。 这些调查结果突出了将广泛的语言模型能力与结构化域知识相结合的价值。 我们为基于任务复杂度和计算限制选择LLM-KG整合策略提供实用指导,并讨论用于个性化医学,认知障碍诊断和解释性AI的混合神经元结构.

articles.title: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
articles.content: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLM-辅助标签噪声校正基于EEG的睡眠阶段分类
articles.content_zh: 从脑电图(EEG)信号中自动进行睡眠阶段分类是临床睡眠医学中的一项关键任务. 虽然深层次的学习模式已在这一领域显示出有希望的成果,但其业绩却受到培训标签质量的根本制约,而人类专家手动对标签作了注释,而且这些标签还受到不同方之间的分歧和系统性标签错误的影响。 在本文中,我们提出一个新的LLM辅助标签-噪声过滤管道,该管道专门在训练期间运作,以便在重新培训分类人员之前识别并删除不可靠的睡眠阶段说明。 具体而言,TinySleepNet首先接受原始数据集的培训,以提取每个时段的SoftMax信心分数,然后将低自信的时段连同其EEG光谱特征和周围序列上下文提交LLaMA 3.1. LLM对照AASM睡眠评分指南评价每个时代,并指定一个RELIAL或SUSPICIOUS的判定. 怀疑的时代被从训练集中移除,TinySleepNet在清理数据上被重新训练. 通过20倍交叉验证对Sleep-EDF扩展数据集进行评估,我们的方法提高了总体准确度,从81.8%提高到84.6%,Macro F1-score从75.6%提高到77.4%,在REM检测方面尤其显著。 关键的是,由于LLM只在训练期间运行,轻量级的TinySleepNet架构(1.3M参数)在推论中得以保留,使得拟议的管道适合实时,可穿戴的睡眠监测应用.

articles.title: Measured Coupling for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion language models can write many tokens per step, but must choose which tokens are safe to commit together. Mean-field decoding penalizes pairs of positions whose predictions look alike. We replace this proxy with the coupling itself: how much committing one token changes the model's confidence at another. Cheap probes inside the main forward pass measure it, with no training or extra model, and it plugs into the same mean-field rule. On three models and four benchmarks, our method needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding and is faster in most settings, also with a key-value cache, at an average accuracy cost of 1.1 points. Shuffling the couplings or replacing them with a uniform bonus loses this gain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在传播语言模型中并行解码的测量拼接
articles.content_zh: 传播语言模型每步可以写许多符,但必须选择哪些符是安全的,可以共同承诺. 中场解码会惩罚一对位置,其预测是相同的. 我们用连结本身来代替这个代名词:一个符号的花费多少会改变模型对另一个符号的信心. 主前方的廉价探测器测量它,没有训练或额外的模型,它插进同样的中场规则. 在三个模型和四个基准上,我们的方法所需步骤远少于中场解码,在大多数设置中更快,也有键值缓存,平均精度成本为1.1分. 擦掉接合物或者用统一奖金来代替它们,就失去了这一收益.

articles.title: Multimodal-SEA: Benchmarking AI Agent Security under Multimodal Social Engineering Attacks
articles.content: Personal AI agents face social engineering attacks supported by forged multimodal content, but existing evaluations mainly focus on text-based dialogue, leaving their intrinsic security under such attacks insufficiently studied. We introduce Multimodal-SEA, an interactive benchmark comprising 608 expert-designed tasks grounded in real-world fraud cases, covering 14 domains and 152 attack scenarios with prepared multimodal content. The tasks span four difficulty levels and reflect the distinct social and cultural contexts of Chinese and English environments. Agents inspect content, verify requests, and execute actions in simulated applications, with attack outcomes grounded in verifiable tool execution logs. To enable controlled red teaming of personal agents, we design a multimodal attack harness that integrates task information, attack progression control, and multimodal content construction to evaluate their intrinsic security against adaptive social engineering attacks in simulated environments. Evaluating seven widely used multimodal models across six dimensions reveals that all are vulnerable, with attack success rates of 7.1% to 34.5%. Adding multimodal content increases attack success from 19.9% to 29.2%, despite increased proactive verification coverage. Stronger safety instructions reduce attack success without improving recognition of deceptive multimodal content, while lower attack success rates for some models accompany excessive refusal of legitimate requests.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多式联运-SEA:在多式联运社会工程袭击下建立AI代理安全基准
articles.content_zh: 个人人工智能特工面临被伪造的多式联运内容所支持的社会工程攻击,但现有的评价主要侧重于基于文本的对话,使他们在这种攻击下的内在安全得不到充分的研究. 我们采用多式联运-SEA,这是一个互动基准,由608项专家设计的任务组成,以现实世界的欺诈案件为基础,涵盖14个领域和152个攻击情况,并附有已准备好的多式联运内容。 任务跨越四个难度层次,反映了中英环境独特的社会和文化背景. 代理人检查内容,核实请求,并在模拟应用中执行动作,攻击结果基于可核查的工具执行记录. 为了能够控制红色的团队化个人代理,我们设计了一套多模式攻击工具,将任务信息整合起来,攻击进化控制,以及多模式内容构建,以评价其内在安全性,对抗模拟环境下的适应性社会工程攻击. 对六个层面广泛使用的七种多式联运模式进行评估后发现,所有模式都十分脆弱,攻击成功率为7.1%-34.5%。 增加多式联运内容使成功率从19.9%增至29.2%,尽管主动核查范围有所扩大。 更有力的安全指示降低了攻击成功率,而没有提高对欺骗性多式联运内容的认识,而某些模型的攻击成功率较低,同时伴随着对合法请求的过度拒绝。

articles.title: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
articles.content: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 模拟视角几何: 将多种语文模式中的表述和行为分开
articles.content_zh: 多种语文模式可以模拟不同的观察者,但目前仍不清楚所指定的观点如何重塑其内部表述方式,以及这些变化是否指导其判断。 在这里,我们调查了在Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct中人物条件视觉趣味性的代表性几何. 在100个图像和53个提示性条件中,我们系统地改变人物的内容和用来介绍它的语言框架,同时记录行为评级和层次隐藏状态。 我们观测到整个处理深度的代表性几何的系统重组:早期的层主要编码图像身份,而人特异的结构则出现在后来的层中. 令人吃惊的是,迅速的设定比个人身份更能重新塑造内部代表,而个人内容对行为判断的影响更大。 这种脱离进一步表现在身份声明的最小程度上,即使没有改变答复,也会改变表述。 这些调查结果表明,代表距离不一定反映行为相关性。 更广泛地说,它们揭示了模拟视角是如何在人工认知系统的代表空间中作为独特的结构出现的,突出了内部代表的几何及其功能后果之间的根本区别.

articles.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
articles.content: Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023--2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent returns one JSON artifact, scored on the numeric core of the final question against a reproduction of the Outstanding-award paper. Two design choices distinguish it: direction-aware, one-sided scoring, which never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification---a programmatic gate over six decidable invariant forms plus 624 Lean~4 obligations---with a hard gate that zeroes infeasible answers. Each task is scored against a panel of human outstanding papers rather than one, so a model must be close to many accepted answers; across seven multimodal entries (three seeds each) the strongest reach a multi-reference O-Eval of 64.58\%, while the \$2.54 open model holds 59.81\% at $1/100$ the cost. TB-MathModel turns the numeric core of modeling into a reproducible, machine-checkable signal for measuring long-horizon modeling competence and for collecting agent trajectories. The source code is available at https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 终端式数学建模座椅:数学建模的第一代理和可验证基准
articles.content_zh: 数学模型化将一个没有限制的现实世界问题转变为假设、模型、解决方案和被辩护的建议,其答案只有在既接近可信的参考,又在物理上可行的情况下才重要;现有的基准要么是分数解决者碎片,要么是使用LLM法官的分数报告,使这些数字不受限制。 我们引入了TB-Math Model(终端式数学模拟座椅),这是第一个使完整的竞赛式模拟问题具有代理性,可核查性,并同时具有终端性的基准,超过18个真正的CUMCM和MCM问题(2023-2025年). 每个任务将逐字记录、正式附件和数字装入集装箱式终端;代理人返回一个JSON文物,在最后问题的数字核心上得分,而不是复制一份杰出奖状。 两个设计选择区别于它:方向意识,片面评分,它从来不会惩罚击败锚,两个层次的可行性验证——一个方案门,它比六个可破解的无变体外加624 Lean~4义务外加一个硬门,这个硬门是零不可行的答案. 每项任务都是对照一组人类杰出的论文而不是一张打分,所以一个模型必须接近许多被接受的答案;通过7个多式联运条目(每个种子3个),最强者达到64.58\%的多参照O-Eval,而\$2.54的开放式模型则以1/100美元的成本持有59.81\%. TB-MathModel将建模的数值核心转换成可复制的,机器可检查的信号,用于测量长视距建模能力并收集剂轨迹. 源代码见https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling.

articles.title: From Twisted Facts to Rogue Agents: Can LLMs Reliably Detect Multi-Dimensional Hallucinations?
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for information access, content production, and agent-based task execution, but their outputs remain vulnerable to subtle, high-risk hallucinations. To systematically evaluate and advance post-generation hallucination detection, we introduce HaluCheck, a large-scale, bilingual benchmark comprising over 42k instances spanning both factual hallucinations in text and faithfulness hallucinations in agent trajectories. HaluCheck features fine-grained, multi-level annotations for detection, localization, and correction, covering different tasks and perturbation degrees. Experiments on fourteen LLMs reveal that, while models show basic sample-level detection ability, they struggle with fine-grained localization, correction, and agent hallucination detection. Further analysis demonstrates that thinking, web search, and supervised fine-tuning each offer partial improvements, but none fully solve the problem. HaluCheck thus provides a solid basis for benchmarking and diagnosing LLM reliability across text and agent scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从曲折的事实到流氓特工:LLMs能否可靠地检测到多种幻觉?
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)被广泛用于信息访问,内容制作,以及基于代理的任务执行,但其输出仍然容易受到微妙,高风险的幻觉的影响. 为了系统地评估和推进产生后幻觉的检测,我们采用了HaluCheck这一大规模双语基准,包括42千多例文字中的事实幻觉和物剂轨迹中的忠实幻觉。 HaluCheck具有精细的,多层次的说明,用于检测,本地化,以及校正,涵盖不同的任务和扰动度. 对14个LLMs的实验表明,虽然模型显示出基本的样本水平检测能力,但它们与精细的局部化,校正,以及剂幻觉检测等有困难. 进一步的分析表明,思考、网络搜索和监督下的微调每一次都提供了部分改进,但都没有完全解决问题。 因此,HaluCheck为在文本和代理情景中确定基准和诊断LLM可靠性提供了坚实的基础。

articles.title: "Blind Compliance": Coercive Control in AI Jailbreaking
articles.content: The explosion of generative AI systems and concerns surrounding their rapidly scaling capabilities has led to an adversarial cycle between increasingly narrow content restrictions ("guardrails") and increasingly sophisticated structured prompting techniques ("jailbreaks"). Technological frameworks surrounding such jailbreaking remain largely focused on the system's output: whether harmful or disallowed content is ultimately produced for the user. However, this approach, which draws largely from classical cybersecurity, does not address the uniquely relational dimension introduced by generative AI: in many cases the user is not just accessing a technology via an exploit, but is in conversation with it as part of the exploit. Here we present an alternative lens which centers the interaction rather than the output. Drawing on interpersonal violence scholarship, we present a novel framework of coercive control categories with a particular focus on aspects which are embodied versus disembodied. We then map how these disembodied coercive control dynamics are structurally embedded in modern AI training paradigms, and how those embeddings are exploited via a particular suite of persona-based jailbreaks. In this lens, we reframe AI safety and alignment as not merely a technical security problem, but as another surface upon which we see enacted the relational dynamics of power and control.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: "Blind合规":AI监狱的强制控制
articles.content_zh: 基因AI系统的爆炸和围绕其快速缩放能力的担忧,导致了日益狭窄的内容限制("护栏")和日益精密的结构化的催化技术("监狱破裂")之间的对抗循环. 围绕这种越狱行为的技术框架仍然主要侧重于系统的产出:无论是有害的还是不允许的内容最终是为用户制作的。 然而,这种方法主要借鉴了古典网络安全,并没有解决基因AI引入的独特关系维度:在许多情况下,用户不只是通过开发获取某项技术,而是作为开发的一部分与之对话. 在这里,我们提出一个替代的镜头,它以互动而不是输出为中心。 我们利用人际暴力奖学金,提出了一套新的强制控制类别框架,特别注重体现的方面和不健全的方面。 然后,我们描绘这些不健全的强制控制动态是如何从结构上嵌入现代人工智能培训范式的,以及这些嵌入是如何通过一套基于个人的越狱行为加以利用的。 在这个角度上,我们重新界定了AI的安全性和一致性,认为它不仅仅是一个技术安全问题,而是一个我们所看到的另一面,它规定了权力和控制的关系动态。

articles.title: Agent-R$^2$: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
articles.content: Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans. However, current agents still struggle to finish such tasks, where success requires following long-horizon professional workflows, understanding heterogeneous file contexts, and producing usable deliverables under fine-grained requirements. A key bottleneck is the lack of scalable post-training data that reflects real work intent, authentic file environments, and deliverable-level evaluation. To close this gap, we introduce Agent-R$^2$, a $\textbf{r}$eal-source data synthesis framework that scales training data for $\textbf{r}$ealistic productivity work. Instead of relying on manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files, Agent-R$^2$ grounds synthesis throughout the pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced files. From 10k web-corpus candidates, Agent-R$^2$ distills 4k task instances that pair real multi-format attachments with fine-grained, deliverable-level rubrics. On this data, we train Agent-R$^2$-4B via supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning, improving both end-to-end productivity performance and file-grounded reasoning. Trained on only 4k instances, Agent-R$^2$-4B surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on both GDPval (51.0$\%$ vs. 48.0$\%$) and OfficeQA (14.8$\%$ vs. 13.8$\%$). Further analysis shows that Agent-R$^2$ mitigates shortcut behavior, where agents produce superficially plausible deliverables before sufficiently grounding, constructing, or verifying them, while promoting sustained exploration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Agent-R$ ^2$: 增强现实生产力的代理 通过真实源数据合成工作
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在代理推理和工具使用方面取得了迅速进展,提高了对能够从人类手中接管现实生产力工作的代理者的期望. 然而,目前的代理人仍然难以完成这些任务,因为要取得成功,就必须遵循长期的专业工作流程,了解不同的文件背景,并根据精细要求提供可用的可交付成果。 一个关键的瓶颈是缺乏反映真实工作意图、真实文件环境和可交付级评价的可扩展培训后数据。 为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了Agent-R$^2$,一个$\textbf{r}$eal-source数据合成框架,用于对$\textbf{r}的生产率工作进行规模化培训数据. Agent-R$^2美元不依靠人工指定的工作流程或LLM生成的文件,而是在真正的职业种子中在整个管道中进行场面合成,由物源生成的工作流程证据,以及真实的网络源文件. 从10k的Web-corpus候选中,Agent-R$^2美元蒸馏了4k任务例,将真实的多格式附件与精细的,可交付级的面额组合在一起. 在这个数据上,我们通过有监督的微调和基于粗略的强化学习来培训Agent-R$^2$-4B,提高端到端的生产力性能和基于文件的推理. 仅在4k个案例中接受了培训,在GDP值(51.0美元对48.0美元)和OfficeQA(14.8美元对13.8美元)中,Agent-R$^2美元-4B超过了Qune3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507。 进一步的分析表明,代理商-R$2美元减轻了捷径行为,即代理商在充分铺设、构筑或核实捷径之前,在推动持续探索的同时,产生表面可信的可交付成果。

articles.title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs
articles.content: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ProQuant:边际MLLM的逐步量化-认识培训
articles.content_zh: 具有令人印象深刻的感知和理解能力的多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)将使得一系列下游应用成为可能. 然而,它们的大量计算和内存要求阻碍了现实世界的实施,特别是对受资源制约的边缘设备。 量子化已成为部署大型模型的有效解决方案. 虽然训练后量子化(PTQ)成功保留了中等比特宽的性能(如W8A8),但在低比特量子化(如W4A8)下,其性能严重退化,尤其是对于更适合边缘部署的小型模型而言. 在本文中,我们提出ProQuant,一个为低位的MLLMs量身定制的新型重量-激活量子-意识培训(QAT)框架. 首先,为了使有限的微调数据集分布与预先训练的数据集分布保持一致,我们提议一个自我重贴标签(SRL)方案,以重新模拟开源多式联运数据集的响应. 第二,我们首先对多模式理解和语言建模能力采取脱钩的观点。 我们建议建立一个渐进区块激活机制,以优先考虑MM理解的恢复。 我们还引入了一个对视觉敏感的系数$\vec\$,有效识别MM关键层. 跨越各种基准的广泛实验,涵盖有2B-8B参数的模型,表明ProQuant大大超过现有方法. 例如,我们的W4A8 Quen3-VL-2B-指令将平均精度提高了6.6%,并实现了与完全精度对应的性能可比较,性能下降率只有1%左右. 代码见https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/。

articles.title: SMART: State-based Multi Agent Reasoning Traces for Verification-oriented Problem-Solving
articles.content: Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART's knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SMART:以国家为基地的多剂理由追踪,以核查为目的解决问题
articles.content_zh: 索赔等环境有限的复杂问题,需要获得解决推理所需的额外知识。 我们提议建立一个多代理框架,即SMART,通过掌握参与实体在问题背景下的隐含状态获取知识。 SMART利用各种有限责任和基于作用的结构化快速战略,将国家知识分为多样、互补和有解决方案的前提。 SMART运用这些真实世界中经过验证的馆舍的知识, 指导解析推理, 我们表明,在现实世界的知识中扎根是必需的,并且能提高5%的绩效。

articles.title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
articles.content: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.

articles.title_zh: 了解何时教学:在多种语言理性扭曲中学习可教学的前缀
articles.content_zh: On-Political Self-Distillation(OPSD)通过对学生进行自己的推理培训,使用与教师一样的以参考解决方案为条件的模式来改进推理. 将OPSD应用于多语种推理需要老师提供跨语言的有用反馈,即使学生在中间步骤中出错. 我们观察到一种我们称之为“漂流老师”的现象:随着这些错误的累积,老师可能遵循学生的错误步骤,而不是纠正这些错误。 我们的分析表明,这种转变往往是在资源较少的语言中较早发生的。 为了说明不同语言之间的这些差异,我们提议采用可教学的“政策上自我分散”,以确定教师的监督应如何和是否适用于每个推理轨迹。 TOPSD使用师生概率来估计漂移开始的地点,并选择一个前缀来进行监督. 然后验证老师是否能够从前缀中恢复正确的答案,将蒸馏只应用于通过验证的前缀. 关于十种语言和三种模型尺度的多语种数学推理的实验表明,TOPSD一贯优于常规OPSD,特别是中低资源语言.

articles.title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection
articles.content: LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. Evaluation across diverse tasks and heterogeneous LLM services shows that RouteAlign extends the empirical quality-cost frontier toward higher task quality. Comparisons with open Jev-style decision backends show consistent quality gains, with lower generation cost than their strongest tested configuration. Ablations support the contribution of local performance evidence, while catalog-update experiments demonstrate effective reuse of the fitted scorer with refreshed model measurements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 路由对齐:将任务要求与 LLM 服务选择的模型配置相匹配
articles.content_zh: LLM服务选择需要反映当前任务要求的性能证据. 综合分数掩盖了能力和难度的差异,而精密相关的例子可能涉及不同的技能组合. 我们介绍的是RouteAlign,它使用任务要求来安排模型性能的衡量和服务的选择. 任务要求描述了能力需求和难度,使得能够与相应的模型性能测量保持一致. 历史要求决定成果如何有助于全球概况和地方能力估计;即将到来的要求决定这些计量如何为当前决定提供依据。 共享计分员整合证据,代成本优先控制合格服务的选择. 对不同任务和不同LLM服务的评价表明,RouteAlign将经验性的质量成本前沿延伸到更高的任务质量。 与开放的Jev风格决策后端的比较显示,质量收益一致,其生成成本低于其最强的测试配置. 缩写支持了当地性能证据的贡献,而编目更新实验则证明,配有刷新模型测量的计分器有效再利用.

articles.title: Beyond K/V Caches: Cross-Model State Handoff in Hybrid Linear-Attention LLMs
articles.content: Production deployments often use different models to balance cost and quality through cascading, routing, and switching models during long conversations. Context accumulates across turns. Each switch requires the target to repeat prefill over this context. Existing methods transfer full-attention (FA) K/V caches across models. Hybrid linear-attention models also retain recurrent states (REC) and convolution histories (Conv). The interaction between Conv and REC complicates cross-model state transfer. Conv perturbations can change keys and values in recurrent layers and alter REC updates. Conv histories are overwritten, but changes in REC can still affect later outputs. More accurate REC reconstruction need not improve continuation. Building on this, we propose Hybrid State Transfer (HST) for all three state types. It uses structured REC maps and preserves history order during Conv alignment. We calibrate the adapters using the frozen target's outputs during continuation. FA cache map updates are merged offline. Across five benchmarks, Qwen3.5 4B$\rightarrow$27B and 9B$\rightarrow$27B achieve mean task retentions of 89.88% and 94.11%, respectively. With source caches already available, separate timing on synthetic 16K inputs yields handoff body speedups of $21.66\times$ and $21.91\times$.

articles.title_zh: 超过 K/V Caches:混合线-留守LLMS中的跨模态交接器
articles.content_zh: 生产部署经常使用不同的模型,在长对话中通过串联,路由和切换模型来平衡成本和质量. 环境会相互累积。 每个切换需要目标在此上下文上重复预填. 现有方法将全心全意(FA)K/V缓存跨模型传输. 混合线性留念模型也保留了重复状态(REC)和演化历史(Conv). Conv和REC之间的互动使跨型态转移复杂化. Conv扰动可以在经常层中改变键和值,并改变REC的更新. Convolution历史被覆盖,但REC的变化仍然可能影响以后的产出. 更准确地说,区域经济共同体的重建不需要改进连续性。 在此基础上,我们提议对所有三种国家类型实行混合国家转让。 它使用结构化的REC地图,并在Conv对齐期间维护历史秩序. 在继续期间,我们利用被冻结的目标的输出来校准适配器。 FA缓存地图更新合并下线. 在5个基准中,Quen3.5 4B美元=27B和9B美元=27B的平均任务保留率分别为89.88%和94.11%。 由于已有源缓存,在合成的16K输入器上单独计时产生交接机身速度21.66美元和21.91美元.

articles.title: Gabor Gabor: E-Gaborformer, a Strictly Causal Speech Recognizer with Gabor-Dictionary Convolutions and Delta-Rule Memory
articles.content: Real-time voice agents need a speech recognizer that never waits for future audio and whose memory per call does not grow with the length of the call. We present E-Gaborformer, a strictly causal encoder that combines Gated DeltaNet-2 recurrent layers with sliding-window attention in a 3:1 ratio, and builds every temporal convolution from a fixed dictionary of causal Gabor atoms. Its streaming state is constant, about 19 MB per call at production scale including the prediction network, where a causal-attention encoder of the same size accumulates over 1 GB after ten minutes. In a controlled causal study on LibriSpeech, E-Gaborformer leaves the initial plateau earlier, reaches a given accuracy up to 18% sooner, and matches or beats an E-Branchformer trained with the identical front end and recipe. At production scale, a 0.6B-parameter Hebrew and English streaming transducer built on E-Gaborformer has 28 to 31% lower word error rate (WER) than NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming, a model of the same size, on English voice-agent traffic, and up to 20% lower Hebrew WER than our previous production system. The same weights serve strictly causal and 480 ms-lookahead decoding with no loss in accuracy, and a two-class formulation of the RNN-T lattice trains the transducer 2.6x faster with exact loss and gradients.
