articles.title_zh: Gabor Gabor: E-Gaborformer,一个带有Gabor-Dictionary Convolutions和Delta-Rule内存的严格causal Speech识别器
articles.content_zh: 实时语音代理需要一个语音识别器,它永远不会等待未来的音频,并且每个呼叫的内存不会随着呼叫的长度而增长. 我们提出E-Gaborformer, 一种完全因果编码器, 将 Gated DeltaNet-2 经常层和滑窗的注意力结合成 3:1 比例, 并且从一个因果 Gabor 原子的固定字典中构建出每一个时间演化。 其流线状态不变,在生产规模下,包括预测网络中,大约每个调用19 MB,一个大小相同的因果-注意编码器在10分钟后累计超过1 GB. 在LibriSpeech的受控因果研究中,E-Gaborformer先离开初始高原,提前达到一定的精度,达到18%,并匹配或击败受过相同前端和食谱训练的E-Branchformer. 在生产规模上,在E-Gaborformer上建造的0.6B参数的希伯来语和英语流传转器比NVIDIA的Nemotron 3.5 ASR的字差率低28%至31% 流体,一个大小相同的模型,在英语语音代理流量上, 并且比我们之前的制作系统低20%的希伯来WER. 同样的权重服务于严格的因果和480ms-lookahead解码,精确度没有损失,RNN-T拉蒂斯的双级配体用精确的损耗和梯度来更快地训练转录器2.6x.

articles.title: ATHAAR: A Medieval Scientific Arabic Manuscript Dataset for Handwritten Text Recognition
articles.content: Despite recent progress in handwritten text recognition, medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts remain an open challenge for current vision-language models (VLMs) due to cursive ligatures, variable diacritization, and more importantly the lack of training data. This paper aims to address this gap, by proposing the first annotation guidelines dedicated to the transcription of scientific Arabic manuscripts inspired by textual criticism, a well-established approach to historical text editing. We then propose, ATHAAR, a new dataset manually annotated following this guideline. Unlike previous resources in the field, ATHAAR varies both witnesses of the same text, calligraphic styles, and content to deal with texts but also numerals. Relying on state-of-the-art VLMs, we finally design a set of experiments to study models transfer across scripts, chapters, and treatises. Our findings highlight the limitations of current systems when faced with the specificities of ancient scientific texts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ATHAAR:用于手写文字识别的中世纪科学阿拉伯语手写语言数据集
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在手写文字识别方面取得了进展,但中世纪的阿拉伯科学手稿仍然对当前视觉语言模型(VLMs)来说是一个公开的挑战,因为咒语结扎,可变的二化,更重要的是缺乏培训数据. 本文旨在弥补这一差距,提出第一个专门对受到文字批评的阿拉伯科学手稿进行抄录的说明准则,这是历史文字编辑的既定办法。 然后,我们提议,ATHAAR公司根据这项准则,采用人工附加说明的新数据集。 与之前的字段资源不同,ATHAAR既不同于同一文本的目击者,书法风格,也不同于处理文本的内容,但也不同于数字. 依靠最先进的VLM,我们最终设计了一套实验来研究跨脚本,章节和论文的模型转移. 我们的研究结果突出了在面对古代科学文本的特殊性时,现有系统的局限性。

articles.title: Linguistic boundaries emerge from pressure-constrained processing dynamics
articles.content: Human cognition organizes continuous experience into bounded units while maintaining continuity across them. Linguistic elements are also organized into bounded structural units such as words and phrases, with sentence marking the final bound of a grammatical construction process. How do such boundaries emerge? We propose boundaries emerge from interacting demands to maintain unresolved dependencies, integrate completed relations, and update semantic context, with structural completion allowing but not determining closure. First, in a generative simulation without predefined boundary positions or constituent labels, these demands produced sentence-like segment-length distributions and distinct characteristic timescales, with structural completion allowing but not determining closure. Near boundaries, unresolved dependency load declined, integration cost peaked, and accumulated pressure reset. Then, we tested whether same demands predicted human listeners' boundary choices during comprehension. Listeners were more likely to mark boundaries with fewer unresolved dependencies, higher integration cost and semantic mismatch, and elevated preceding memory load, beyond syntactic and prosodic cues. Third, in naturalistic self-paced reading, sentence-final slowing coincided with declining memory load and increasing integration cost and semantic mismatch, broadly consistent with the simulation. Processing same narratives with a large language model revealed increased local intrinsic dimensionality and straighter hidden-state trajectories at sentence endings, followed by larger representational updates. Boundary explained additional variation in reading time and hidden-state geometry beyond processing demands, but considerably less in next-token surprisal. Together, these findings suggest linguistic boundaries emerge as discrete manifestations of transitions in continuous processing dynamics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 受压力制约的加工动态产生的语言界限
articles.content_zh: 人类认知组织连续经验进入有界限的单位,同时保持它们之间的连续性. 语言元素还被组织成词和短语等有界限的结构单元,句子标注了语法构造过程的最终约束. 这种界限是如何出现的? 我们提出边界来自相互作用的要求,以维持尚未解决的依赖关系,整合已完成的关系,并更新语义背景,结构完成允许但不能决定关闭。 首先,在没有预先界定的边界位置或组成标签的基因模拟中,这些要求产生了类句子的段长分布和独特的特征时间尺度,结构完成允许但不能确定关闭。 边界附近,未解决的依赖负荷下降,集成成本达到峰值,累积压力重置. 然后,我们测试同样的要求 预测人类听众的边界选择 在理解。 监听者更有可能在未解决的依赖性较少、集成成本较高和语义不匹配以及先前的内存负载增加的情况下标出边界,超出了协同和Prosotic提示。 第三,在自然主义的自我节奏阅读中,句子-最终的减速与内存负载下降,集成成本和语义错配率增加同时进行,与模拟基本一致. 用大型语言模型处理相同的叙事,揭示了地方内在维度增加,句尾有更直的隐藏状态轨迹,之后是更大的代表更新. 边界解释了阅读时间和隐藏状态几何学在处理需求之外的其他差异,但在下层占地几何中则少得多。 这些研究结果表明,语言边界是连续处理动态中过渡的离散表现。

articles.title: Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for language-model post-training, combining dense teacher supervision with training on student-generated trajectories. This creates a feedback loop where each update changes the student and thereby the training distribution that generates subsequent updates. Yet, how this feedback shapes learning and generalization remains poorly understood. We conduct a mechanistic analysis of OPD's learning dynamics, distinguishing the two feedback loop stages: conversion of the distillation signal into parameter updates, and broadcast through which these updates change predictions across prefixes and reshape the rollout distribution. This framework helps us understand both limited student responsiveness despite substantial teacher-student disagreement, and degeneration when updates that improve local teacher agreement also increase the probability of unsuccessful continuations, exposing the student to unreliable supervision in subsequent rollouts. Finally, we show that offline distillation can prepare a student for OPD without significantly improving immediate held-out accuracy. While OPD alone may degrade generation, it can yield substantial accuracy gains after sufficient offline preparation. Together, our results connect teacher supervision, student geometry, and the evolving rollout distribution in determining the learning dynamics of OPD and its effects on downstream performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 政策扭曲的学习动态
articles.content_zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)正在成为语言模式后培训的重要范例,将密集的教师监督与学生生成的轨迹培训结合起来. 这创造了一个反馈循环,每次更新都会改变学生,从而产生后续更新的培训分布. 然而,这种反馈是如何形成学习和概括的,对此仍然认识不足。 我们对OPD的学习动态进行机械分析,区分两个反馈循环阶段:将蒸馏信号转换为参数更新,并通过这些广播更新跨前缀的变化预测并重塑推出分布. 这个框架帮助我们理解学生的反应有限,尽管师生意见大不相同,而且当更新改善当地教师协议也增加了不成功续办的可能性,使学生在随后的推广中面临不可靠的监督时,则会退化。 最后,我们显示,离线蒸馏可以让学生为OPD做好准备,而不会显著提高即时搁置的准确性。 虽然光是OPD就可能降解生成,但经过充分的离线准备后,它就能产生大量的精度增益. 我们的成果共同将教师监督、学生几何学以及不断演变的推广分布联系起来,以确定OPD的学习动态及其对下游业绩的影响。

articles.title: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
articles.content: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自动键词提取和注释:现代理论方法以及文本和语音的实际解决方案
articles.content_zh: 文字和视听信息的成倍增长使自动键词提取(KE)的任务越来越重要。 文章全面分析了现代理论方法以及KE在文字和语音方式上的实际解决方案. 这项工作的主要贡献是系统地综合这些常常是分化的研究线索,形成一个统一的分析框架,突出领域从统计方法向大语言模型(LLM)和端到端语音处理的演变. 我们研究KE的阶段,书面语和口语的关键词的特征,以及名词的细微差别. 对各种自动KE方法进行了详细讨论和分析:统计学,混合学,机器学习学,结构学. 审查相当重视新出现的范式,包括使用LLMs生成关键词,并详细概述了自动实体说明的方法和挑战。 此外,我们特别分析了KE中当前对口语的走向和固有的困难,比较了基于记录和端到端的声学方法. 这一综述使我们得出这样的结论,即这个领域正朝着一个更加综合、更加了解背景的范式迈进。 未来的进展将取决于如何应对关键的挑战,如资源匮乏的语言、有效的多式联运组合以及对基因型KE系统的细微评价。

articles.title: Compression Through a Context Lens: Evaluating Adaptation, Quantization, and Distillation in Arabic Legal LLMs
articles.content: Model compression can facilitate the deployment of large language models in resource-constrained legal settings, but its effects on domain-specific performance may depend on the evaluation protocol. We investigate this issue using ArabLegalEval, a Saudi Arabic legal benchmark, under both with-context and no-context evaluation. The former provides supporting legal passages, while the latter assesses performance without external context. Removing the context produces accuracy gaps of up to 27 percentage points for the base model. We examine three stages: domain adaptation, quantization, and knowledge distillation across FANAR-9B, JAIS-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B. Four-bit quantization reduces model memory by 64-71%, with changes in no-context MCQ accuracy ranging from -3.2 to +1.6 percentage points. Distillation produces more variable results, with accuracy generally declining as student size decreases. A Qwen2.5-7B student distilled from FANAR achieves 76.6% no-context accuracy, compared with 77.2% for its teacher. Our findings suggest that no-context evaluation provides a useful complement to context-supported testing when assessing the effects of adaptation and compression on Arabic legal language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过上下文进行压缩:在阿拉伯文法律课程中评价适应、量化和消沉
articles.content_zh: 模型压缩可以促进大型语言模型在受资源限制的法律环境中的部署,但其对特定域性能的影响可能取决于评价协议. 我们利用阿拉伯法律(Arab LegalEval)这一沙特阿拉伯法律基准, 前者提供辅助性法律段落,后者在没有外部背景的情况下评估业绩。 删除上下文后,基准模型的准确性差距高达27个百分点。 我们研究了三个阶段:域适应、量化和跨越FANAR-9B的知识蒸馏、JAIS-8B和Quen2.5-7B。 四位量化将模型内存减少64-71%,无文本的MCQ精度变化从-3.2到+1.6个百分点不等. 蒸馏产生更多可变的结果,随着学生人数的减少,准确性普遍下降. 一个从FANAR中蒸馏出来的Quen2.5-7B学生实现了76.6%的无文本精度,而其老师为77.2%. 我们的调查结果表明,在评估适应和压缩对阿拉伯法律语言模型的影响时,无文字评价为上下文支持的测试提供了有益的补充。

articles.title: How Far Can Lightweight LLMs Go in Intent-to-SLO Translation?
articles.content: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. The best configurations translate intents with a strict F1 of 0.943 and reject up to 191 of 195 invalid intents. With few-shot reasoning, the strongest models hallucinate unsupported QoS requirements in only about one response in a hundred, whereas the zero-shot setup struggles. A translated intent costs 0.044-0.148 Wh of GPU energy without reasoning, and added energy cost for reasoning pays off for the weaker models. Furthermore, we show that realistic rephrasing lowers the rejection of invalid intents in 15 of 16 configurations for the best-performing models, leaving robust intent validation as a key open challenge for reliable IBN. Our code and data are available: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo.

articles.title_zh: 轻量级LLMs在SLO翻译中有多远?
articles.content_zh: 基于意向的网络(IBN)承诺提供QoS,网络从操作员陈述的目标中获取配置. 其第一步,将自然语言意图转化为可执行的服务级目标(SLOs),以网络状态的现场快照为基础,越来越依赖于大型语言模型(LLMs). 这些大型模型为管理循环增加了成本和能量,通常需要多GPU,云宿基础设施. 轻量级开放LLMs能否可靠地接手这一步? 我们在回答这个问题时,对5个家庭的10个LLMs进行了五维评价,在4个提示下,对716个安置意图进行了小于10B的参数。 我们评价翻译的性能,意向验证,幻觉,能量影响,以及对多种措辞的稳健性. 最好的配置翻译意向,严格的F1为0.943,并拒绝195种无效意向中的多达191种. 以几发的推理,最强的模型在大约百分之一的响应中会幻觉得不到支持的QoS要求,而零发的设置则会挣扎. 翻译意向费 0.044-0.148 GPU能量的WH没有推理, 加上推理的能量成本为较弱的模型带来收益。 此外,我们显示,现实的重写降低了16种组合中15种最佳模式对无效意图的拒绝,使强有力的意图验证成为可靠的IBN的关键公开挑战。 我们的代码和数据见https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo。

articles.title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
articles.content: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving, solver engineering, and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures, capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. The TCSExam Index combines all four tracks: GPT-6 Astra leads Full (71.9), and Opus 5.5 leads Lite (72.3). Full and Lite rankings are strongly aligned across eight shared agents (Spearman's $ρ=0.93$), supporting Lite as a compact, discriminative benchmark. The evaluations yield improved solver outputs and mathematical constructions, together with independently verified special cases and bounds from open-conjecture attempts. TCSExam provides an extensible framework with task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools for reproducible use.

articles.title: CoRD: Coupled Rollouts Fill the Blind Spot of On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation trains a student on its own rollouts, so states the teacher would reach but the student does not are seldom supervised. We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), which keeps the on-policy loss and moves only the distribution of training states toward the teacher, drawing rollouts from a geometric interpolation of student and teacher through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding. The coupling keeps the student's token wherever the two distributions agree and otherwise substitutes a token from the part of the target the student underweights, so interventions are as rare as any exact sampler allows and recede as the student learns. Across six base students from two model families (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B to 4B), CoRD raises average pass@1 over on-policy distillation by 0.9 to 2.0 points and pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points on five public math benchmarks at equal steps and data. On frozen teacher-reached states, a 4B student trained with CoRD reaches in 16 steps a gap closure that on-policy distillation does not reach in 80, and substitution rules intervening at least as often in other directions fall short of CoRD.

articles.title_zh: CORD: 合并推出, 填充政策性扭曲的盲点
articles.content_zh: 政策上的提炼训练学生自己推出, 我们引入了CoRD(连锁-推出蒸馏),它保持了政策上的亏损,只将培训状态的分布转向教师,通过最大程度的投机解码组合从学生和教师的几何插图中抽取出。 无论两种分配方式如何商定,组合都保留学生的象征,否则就取代了学生体重不足的目标部分的象征,因此干预像任何精确的采样者所允许的和学生所学习的一样少见. 来自两个模范家庭(Qune3和Qune3.5, 0.6B至4B)的6个基础学生中,CORD将政策提炼的平均通过度@1提高0.9至2.0分,并在5个公共数学基准上以相等的步数和数据通过0.2至3.4分。 在被冻结的教师接触的州,一名接受过CORD训练的4B学生在16个步骤中达到了一个缺口的关闭,而政策蒸馏没有达到80个,而替代规则干预其他方向至少经常低于CORD。

articles.title: A Behavioural Framework for Predicting and Understanding Loss of Control in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Systems
articles.content: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly operating over longer horizons with diminishing human oversight, raising the risk of loss of control: systems acting beyond effective human control with potentially irreversible consequences. Because such failures may become observable only after containment is difficult, they must be assessed prospectively. We introduce a behavioural framework that decomposes loss-of-control risk into three factors: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion. We operationalise these factors through 13 measurable aspects and 29 evaluation tasks, whose scores are combined into a single loss-of-control (LoC) score. Across 13 frontier models, the LoC score shows strong prospective validity, correlating with failure rates in contained long-horizon risk scenarios (Pearson r = 0.84). Risk varies systematically across models and cannot be explained by capability alone. We further show that the framework can guide targeted mitigations: fine-tuning and monitoring directed at diagnosed vulnerabilities reduce failure rates while largely preserving general performance. These results provide a practical basis for predicting, understanding, and mitigating loss-of-control risk before it materialises.

articles.title_zh: 预测和了解边境人工情报系统失控行为框架
articles.content_zh: 边疆人工智能系统越来越多地在更长的视野内运行,人类监督不断减少,增加了失去控制的风险:系统的行为超出了人类的有效控制,可能产生不可逆转的后果。 由于这种失败只有在难以遏制之后才能被观察到,因此必须对之进行前瞻性评估。 我们引入了一个行为框架,将失控风险分解为三个因素:动机错配、伤害能力和监测逃逸。 我们通过13个可衡量方面和29项评价任务将这些因素付诸实施,这些评价任务的分数合并为一个控制丧失分数。 在13个前沿模型中,LoC得分显示出强烈的预期有效性,与包含的长视距风险假设(Pearson r = 0.84)中的故障率有关. 不同模式的风险有系统变化,不能仅以能力来解释。 我们进一步表明,该框架可以指导有针对性的缓解:针对确诊脆弱性的微调和监测可降低故障率,同时在很大程度上保持总体绩效。 这些结果为预测、理解和减轻控制损失风险提供了实际依据,然后才实现。

articles.title: Beyond the Keyword: A Human-Annotated Benchmark for Arabic Anxiety-Related Discourse
articles.content: Keyword retrieval returns expressions of personal anxiety together with many other uses of anxiety-related language. We present a benchmark of 1,000 Arabic Twitter/X posts retrieved with the keyword qalaq ("anxiety/worry") and annotated for six discourse functions. Two native Arabic-speaking annotators labeled every post independently, reaching 51.1% raw agreement (Cohen's $κ= 0.378$). We then reviewed all 489 disagreements and all 511 agreements under the same guidelines. The review changed 120 of the agreed labels (23.5%), which shows that agreements need auditing as well as disagreements. The final labels form a consensus reference; on a random sample of 200 posts, an additional annotator agreed with it on 60.5% of posts ($κ= 0.517$). Against this reference, Fanar-C-2-27B reaches 79.8% accuracy and macro-F1 0.784 ($κ= 0.749$). Its errors concentrate in the residual category (41.1% of errors; precision 0.905, recall 0.447), whose definition is internally inconsistent in the executed prompt, so the low recall cannot be attributed to the model alone. Sociopolitical Anxiety (27.1%) outnumbers Personal Emotional Expression (22.0%); these are assignment proportions in the sample, not estimates of prevalence or retrieval precision. We release the guidelines, a residual-subtype scheme, a fixed data split, label provenance, and evaluation code.

articles.title_zh: 《超越关键词:阿拉伯焦虑相关演讲人性附加说明的基准》
articles.content_zh: 关键词检索返回个人焦虑的表达以及焦虑相关语言的许多其他用途. 使用关键词Qalaq(焦虑/焦虑), 两位讲阿拉伯语的本地书记员将每篇文章标注为独立,达成51.1%的原始协议(Cohen的0.378美元)。 然后,我们根据同样的准则审查了所有489项分歧和所有511项协定。 审查改变了120个商定的标签(23.5%),这表明协议既需要审计,也需要有分歧。 最后的标签构成协商一致的参考;在200个员额的随机抽样中,另有一名注释员同意它关于60.5%的员额(0.517美元)的意见。 据此,Fanar-C-227B的准确度达到79.8%,宏F1 0.784(0.749美元)。 它的错误集中在剩余类别(41.1%的错误;精度0.905,召回0.447),其定义在被执行的即时中内部不一致,因此低的召回不能单独归于模型. 社会政治焦虑(27.1%)多于个人情感表达(22.0%);这些是抽样中的任务比例,而不是对流行程度或检索精度的估计。 我们发布了准则,一个残余的子类型方案,一个固定的数据分割,标签来源,以及评价代码.
